107000.description: Starting today, I retire. But what should I do...... I don't have any talents, and I don't have the brains for business. My only talent is to defeat enemies all over the world. What a pain......
synonyms: The Master of Martial Arts Retired Life

title.english: The Top Martial Artist's Retired Life
title.romaji: Wulin Zhi Wang De Tui Yin Shenghuo

107001.description:
After being proposed to, Mio was on cloud nine. Her life as a newlywed was just about to begin... That is, until her soon-to-be husband leaves her for another woman and she falls into the depths of despair. That's when Eita shows up, a friend from her school days who also just happens to be her fiance's younger brother! He tells Mio he's there for her, then pushes her down onto the bed... Eita teases her with his fingers and tongue, sweetly whispering into her ear, asking if she wants him to stop. It tingles... Her heart won't stop racing!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: In the Wake of a Broken Heart -Sleeping with His Younger Brother-
title.native: 俺がトロトロにしてあげる～私を抱くのは彼の弟～
title.romaji: Ore ga Torotoro ni Shite Ageru: Watashi wo Daku no wa Kare no Otouto

title.native: ミエタミエナイセカイ

107003.description:
Jana’s a talented artist, but she’s also an awkward high school girl. When her first love Conrad transfers to her school, she’s over the moon until this popular genius very publicly denies knowing her. Before she dies from the online shaming, the mysterious creature Dolo has just the thing for her — a capsule to change her destiny! All it requires in exchange is something valuable to her. What will Jana sacrifice to make her dreams come true? Nothing could go wrong… right?

(Source: Tapas)

107004.description: Misaki, a manga artist in her late twenties, is turned down by her crush one day. While drinking away her pain she runs into a handsome younger man who seems to have taken an interest her. She knows he's just playing with her, but she can't help but feel excited as he brings his face close to hers. He assuages her moral doubts and insists she yearn for him. She may be getting used by this young stud... But even so, would it be so bad to indulge herself a little?
synonyms: Anta no Iitoko, Zenbu Oshiete? Zetsurin Danshi no Honki Sex

title.english: Tell Me What You Like -Getting with a Guy Equal to None-
title.native: アンタの良いとこ、ぜんぶ教えて？絶倫男子の本気SEX
title.romaji: Anta no Yoitoko, Zenbu Oshiete? Zetsurin Danshi no Honki Sex

107005.description: This is surely a story you've never thought of! The cartoon’s main character is called Yuan Xin. She’s an otaku who likes to immerse herself in a fantasy world. She, who likes to look at hot guys--after embarrassing herself in front of them in the school yard, decides to retaliate. Unexpectedly, during the crucial moment, an accident happened, and she crossed over to the game world!

107006.description: Joo Sungwan is working as a fake ghost in order to pay back for a broken laptop, but instead of scaring customers, Sungwan is the one being scared! Even worse, there’s an actual ghost living in the haunted house?! With his job on the line, Sungwan ends up in a dating contract with the ghost — in exchange for the ghost scaring visitors, Sungwan must give him three wishes and be his boyfriend.
synonyms: Not for the Faint of Heart

107007.description:
1. Jigoku Elevator (地獄エレベーター)
2. Teru Teru Bouzu (てるてる坊主)
3. Yuurei Life (ゆーれいライフ)
4. Sakura no Shoujo-tachi (櫻の少女たち)
5. Jigoku Shoujo "Samayoeru Koigokoro" (地獄少女「さまよえる恋心」)

title.native: 本当にヤバイホラーストーリー
title.romaji: Hontou ni Yabai Horror Story Tomodachi Jigoku

107008.description:
The assassin Yan Po wipes out all 18 members of the Huang family in one blood-drenched night, stealing the secrets to shape-shifting magic in the process, subsequently disappearing without a trace. One girl from the Huang family survived, vowing to take revenge. 70 years later, the most popular phrase in Chang’an is “As the mantis stalks the cicada, behind them will lurk the Golden Sparrow. I shall not rest until Yan Po appears.

(Source: Tapas)

107013.description:
Mameda is a tanuki who was born in the wrong era - all she wants is to trick humans, but that age of tanuki shenanigans is over. But one woman, a rakugo master named Bunko, shows Mameda it's still possible to cast magic on humans...only with words, not illusions. Mameda is determined to become Bunko's apprentice, but can she convince the stoic master to take her on...?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

title.native: うちの師匠はしっぽがない
title.romaji: Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai

107014.description:
Ryousuke's art is what makes him special, but it also makes him weird. Bullied at school, he hides his art from others, but in doing so, he ends up hiding his true self. That is, until the day he meets a girl painting under an overpass, and this chance encounter inspires him in ways he is only beginning to understand…

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: 佐伯さん家のブラックキャット

107016.description:
Class 2–2 is filled with nothing but standout, eccentric students.
Let’s take a brief peek at the hectic days that unfold in their classroom.

(Source: Ganma!, translated)

107017.description:
Have you ever wished someone dead? Maybe that bully who's harassing you at school could use a permanent vacation? If so, just contact the Tranquility Support Center, and they'll put an end to pesky harassers with good, old-fashioned murder! Of course, there is a price to pay, but it's worth it, right…?

(Source: Mangamo)

title.native: 死逢わせサポートセンター

107018.description:
Arika is what you could charitably call a vampire "enthusiast." When she stumbles across the beautiful and mysterious vampire Divo however, her excitement quickly turns to disappointment as she discovers he's not exactly like the seductive, manipulative villains in her stories. His looks win first place, but his head's a space case.

Armed with her extensive knowledge of vampire lore, Ariko downgrades Divo to a beta vampire and begins their long, long... long journey to educate him in the ways of the undead.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Ringo to Bara to Kyuuketsuki (Temporary Title)
The Apple, the Rose, and the Vampire

title.native: 林檎と薔薇と吸血鬼（仮）
生まれ変わらないでいてくれ

107020.description:
Chika and Aya are in love with the same teacher. Determined to be the victor even if it meant using any means necessary, Chika accidentally comes to know Aya's true nature.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: あの鐘を鳴らすのは少なくともおまえじゃない
title.romaji: Ano Kane wo Narasu no wa Sukunakutomo Omae Janai

107021.description:
Joo-ah lives alone after her grandfather died. She was cleaning her grandfather's mansion when she found a mysterious pumpkin stone ring. At that time, Seok-nam, the spirit in the pumpkin stone, appeared and called Joo-ah a priest!

(Source: Lezhin; translated)

_Note: The chapter count contains an epilogue._

107022.description: In the Heian period, there was a princess whose beauty was exquisite enough to attract even the emperor. She was Princess Kaguya. What will become of an orphaned girl named Tsubaki when she founds out the ridiculous secret that the super famous princess was actually a... man who came from the world above?!

title.native: かぐや姫のかくしごと

107023.description:
When a tough, rebellious Eric arrives at a German boarding school, there is one fellow student he hates: Thoma. Thoma bears a striking resemblance to Eric, but is gentle, delicate, and idolized by his classmates.

(Source: Manga! Manga! The World of Japanese Comics)

107024.description:
A man returns from a trip after hearing news about his former love's passing.

(Source: Golden Roze)

107025.description:
The female boss of the beautiful nightclub Lan plays the fool for the sake of getting a divorce appointed husband. During the daytime she is the ugly wife of Chu’an whom he hates and at night she was the most attractive singer. While her plan is proceeding, her husband’s young handsome remote uncle Sir Qin, a warlord, seems to have found her secret just by chance and falls for her gradually when he gets to know her more and more. Where will this relationship go?

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: Junfa Laogong Zei Huai Hen Hen Bazhan ni

title.native: 军阀老公贼坏：狠狠霸占你
title.romaji: Junfa Laogong Zei Huai: Hen Hen Bazhan Ni

107026.description:
It took her three months to get used to her new identity—Xi's aunt. Every time she watches Xi dates with his new girlfriend, she always feels heartbroken. How could he forget everything? "I was not and am not and will never be your aunt, I am your..." Her mouth is sealed by a kiss before she could finish herwords. "I don't care who you are, I just know that I want to kiss you."
(Source: MangaToon)

107027.description:
Tess, a common high school girl, ran into a genius boy at the nightclub and kissed him accidentally! That kiss reminds him of his disappeared lover... what's the relationship between the nightclub girl and his sweet lover? During the search for the truth, a big conspiracy finally uncovered...

(Source: MangaToon)

107028.description:
She, who was once an ordinary girl, now only wants to cultivate herself and return to the earth as soon as possible. What troubles her most is that her identity is the consort of Fox King in this world. A really clingy one. Wherever she goes, he follows. What is the wrong with his persistence? For love, let's see what can a thousand years fox king do.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 今日から狐王の寵愛受けます
Transmigrated Into the Fox King’s Adored Wife

title.english: Back in Time: The Fox King's Sole Affection
title.romaji: Chuanyue Zhi Hu Wang De Zhuan Chong

107029.description: The next-generation story of Sensual Phrase: Sakuya Ookouchi's new project launches! Sakuya discovers the next-generation hero who will usher in a new era!
synonyms: Sono Koe de, Sono Uta o.

title.romaji: Sono Koe de, Sono Uta wo.

title.romaji: On Air Dekinai! Onna AD Mafuneko (23), TV Bangumi Tsukuttemasu

107031.description: A comic-essay about the experiences of an employee for TV Tokyo.

107032.description:
A new generation sports manga featuring e-sports! Aoba, a lethargic high school student, became inspired by a FPS game, playing with Chizuru, a gal who loves video games! They will challenge the world of e-sport competitions with the unique personalities on his team!

(Source: Cycomics, translated)

title.native: GGWP！ －グッドゲームウェルプレイド！－

107033.description: A comic-essay by KANA about their life after moving to Portland, Oregon, in the summer of 2017.

107035.description:
Kotake Mukouhara Senior High School's soccer team was once the favorite to be the prefectural champions, until ten of their eleven players mysteriously disappeared. Now, only their star forward, Ashida Isami, remains, and his childhood friend Katena Chiyo is in danger of having to marry their rival team's forward if he can score more points than Isami in the championship final!

Note: Published in Young Magazine #6 in 2015, as part of their "Ore no The 100th!!" series, where well-known manga artists attempt to write the 100th chapter of a manga without the other 99

107036.description: A school is transported into a fantasy world that is at war with dragons, and everyone in the school is given a powerful dragon slaying sword, and told the only way to get home is to help win the war. But there is a catch, to use the swords power you must be...a virgin!

title.native: 学園ドラゴンスレイヤー

107037.description: Motokazu has been asked by a physics professor to convince the now-reclusive former child-genius Homizu Saraka to come to class. While he speaks with her, a question comes up that sparks her curiosity: Can humans create a universe? He's able to get her to come to class, but he's also caught up in her brilliant and dangerous plan to see if this is truly possible.

107038.description:
Rie has a violent streak and hates all men after being abandoned by her abusive father, but is saved from attempted sexual assault by her senpai Kousuke. She falls in love and decides to accept an invitation to his house when his parents aren't around.

Note: Published in COMIC KOH Volume 2.

107039.description:
Mother-son incest.

A mother got jealous that her son got so many chocolates on valentine day. She then creates ultimate chocolate for him.

107041.description: Sara is a student in a women-only school and has been raised protected and covered from everything. Until one day she crossed paths with a boy as beautiful as he is dangerous...

title.romaji: Tenshi wa Nido, Uso wo Tsuku

107043.description: A remake of George Akiyama's 1979 manga Gyara.

107045.description: Cheng Yi Nuo was badly framed by her sister. She did not want to give in to fate. She wanted to rely on her intelligence to be an entertainment reporter. She did not expect to shoot on the first mission to her boss?

107046.description:
Badly humiliated by him to pay her father's debts off, she thought she was in hell. She hadn't expected that it was just a beginning and a magnificent revenge. Who on earth was sinking in heart?
(Source: MangaToon)

title.english: The Devil's Game: Training His Sweet Wife
title.romaji: Emo Youxi: Tiaojiao Xiao Tian Qi

107047.description:
Mu Qingge never understood why she and her investor, Dong Fangyan, who spent 70 million to forcibly marry her, don't get along. Why does he pick on her and humiliate her so? With the return of her step-brother Huo Zhangling, the superstar Lu Linghan's kindness to her, and the sudden appearance of the Bai-clan siblings, a past sealed away is slowly being uncovered. What is the secret buried by time? And how will it affect all their lives?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

107048.description:
A sheet of contract and a ransom of ten million changed her into a close maid to an evil-like billionaire. Although once a rich young lady, she was made a puppet nowadays. He tried his best to torture her only to give birth to a boy to revenge against his family? In an attempt to flee away from him, she learnt how to seduce men and contribute her body, swearing to identify who was manipulating her life.
(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: ตื้อหัวใจภรรยาน้อย

107049.description:
Zhu Jinyu is an eighteen-year-old girl who died from overeating and finds herself in the afterlife Her death was a mistake, and to make things right, she was sent to another world as a chubby fairy Reborn as Chichi, she gets to enjoy a new life in a new world where she might possibly find love

(Source: INKR)

107050.description:
Because of a superstition, I was deceived by my beloved to dedicate my wedding night to the King of Yama (king of hell, who masters the life and death people in mortal world), and my parents were sent as sacrifice to the God of River. Although my parents were fine after that, I could not escape from the control of the king of hell...
(Source: WebComics)

107051.description:
How romantic meeting his destined lover in travels! In this story, he picks their shells of memory for her in seaside of Sea of Love, sings for her on the top of minaret in the Flower Citt, and shoots the unique starry night with her. They meet, understand and fall for each other. Miraculous travel ends, their love journey starts. *Note*: Yue in Chinese means moon and Xing stands for stars. That's how the title come from.

(Source: WebComics)

107053.description:
Zhang Nan, the young master of the Hidden Dragon Family, wanted to become an ordinary person, but he was sent to the aristocratic training school by his grandfather. When he was assigned to an all-female class by a confused teacher, Zhang Nan finds himself tortured by these heirs to the brink of dropping out..

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Wo de Fan Pai Nv You

107054.description:
They call her Saintess, a mystical and beautiful holy figure that guides the nation. Suddenly one day, her body has switched with a flippant, crude womanizer! To conceal the emergency, she's sent to hide at a college as a normal student. But how is that possible with a scheme to get rid of her and all these hearts aflutter at school?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

107056.description:
Orphaned at a young age, Alice has lived with her aunt for most of her childhood. But her uncle is abusive and resentful, and at 15 Alice decides to return home to Kyoto and train as a maiko, eventually hoping to become a geisha.

But when she arrives back at her birthplace, she finds that Kyoto has changed quite a bit in the eight years since she left it. Almost as if it's a completely different world...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: ひとっこひとり百鬼の里

synonyms: Gunjou no Ensemble: Ni-nen San-kumi no Seito-tachi
Gunjou no Ensemble: Ninen Sankumi no Seitotachi

107061.description:
Its near the end of the Heian era and Tamamo is a young noblewoman with curly hair something that is seen as ugly and strange. Fallen on hard times after the death of her father and sister because the actions of a cruel nobleman she dreams of revenge. She meets a young man Naoto who is kind and protective towards her. He has amibitions to become an Onmyouji. Due to various circumstances they release an evil fox spirit named Otsuka-sama who promises Nao that she can help her punish the nobles who mistreated her and destroyed her family. All that she requires is her soul.

Can Nao save Tamamo before she is lost to the darkness? The story of “Tamamo-no-mae” and “Nine-tailed fox” begins here!

107063.description: In the second volume is included the one-shot "Okaasan Yubi" (おかあさんゆび), previously published in the yuri anthology "My Sweet Home"

107064.description:
Hashimoto the vampire, who up until now has been getting-by by drinking blood (or rather, milk substituting for blood), has, due to a happening upon a gourmet-food manga come to try human food.

Never-before tasted meals of many varieties, prove for a lip-smackingly great time...or rather, SHOULD have - but being a 260 year-old recluse, he isn't exactly familiar with how things work in the human world, I can't see this going smoothly!

Kaoru, a high school student, falls in love with Sonoko, the leader of his school's swimming club. Although he can not swim, he joins the swim club to seduce her.

107083.description: A modern re-tail of The Little Mermaid. Featuring a delusional mermaid, and a whimsy "prince".

107084.description:
"I'm gonna change my life!!" --- Yuuta, who failed at his job hunting, went to local tattoo shop on impulse with such determination. There, he met a blonde guy with piercing, named Atsushi. On their first meeting, Atsushi confessed he fell in love with Yuuta at the first sight!!
Although Atsushi is a good looking man, skilled at sex and seems like a fun person, while embracing Yuuta, he said, "It's fine if Yuu-kun is the only person by my side."
Because of that, they began to live under the same roof. But, Atsushi always keep his eyes on Yuuta 24/7, and that is to show his possessiveness!?

107086.description: It’s a cute story about a girl and her cell phone that is really the latest in technology and can transform into a boy! Also, the way to upgrade it is non-other than doing intimate things such as kissing! Embarrassing moments and rivals appear!

title.native: 非科学常識ケータイくん!

107087.description:
Juyoon Oh is a typical guy trying to find a full-time job. But one day, he dives into the Han River and puts himself at risk of drowning to save a child that fell in. As he is about to meet an untimely death, a goddess appears before him and gives him a chance at another life... not as a hero or a wizard, but as a weak, skill-less "brick larva." It's the beginning of an atrocious adventure, and the road to become a hero is long!

(Source: Tappytoon)

No Doubt, Even Better Than Sis...

A young couple having their first time together after coming back from the summer festival.

Note: Published in Comic Hotmilk 2019-01

107096.description:
"A harem in another world!?" University student Shiki Satou woke up in another world's dungeon town. There he discovered Healing Magic, but as he did nothing but sexual harassment in exchange for healing others... he finally got fired from the clinic he worked at. He was at a loss, but decides to explore the dungeon as an adventurer to earn a living. That's when he encounters Yuel, a young maimed slave girl...

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: I Work as a Healer in Another World Labyrinth City

title.native: 異世界の迷宮都市で治癒魔法使いやってます
title.romaji: Isekai no Meikyuu Toshi de Chiyu Mahoutsukai Yattemasu

107097.description: Shizuku Hayama is the personal bodyguard for Ichika Kiryuin, the only daughter of a major industrialist. But Ichika is no shrinking violet, and she's perfectly able to handle any dangerous situation or challenge by herself. If Ichika doesn't need anyone protect her body, maybe Shizuku can help to protect her heart?
synonyms: My Lady Won't Let me Protect Her

title.native: お嬢様が護らせてくれない

107098.description:
The story begins when the gods call a conference to decide the whether to let humanity live or die, and settle on destroying humanity. But a lone valkyrie puts forward a suggestion to let the gods and humanity fight one last battle, as a last hope for humanity's continued survival. 13 gods will fight against 13 human champions in one-on-one battles to decide whether humanity lives or dies.

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: มหาศึกคนชนเทพ

107099.description:
The high school columnist looking for the next big story gets more than she bargained for when she digs into the wife of a man she meets. The female anime characters that the class nerd draws become real and over protective of their creator. The monster behind the old child’s story haunts the people that break the rules of the contract. These are some of the episodes in this collection of short horror stories.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

107100.description:
Flum Apricot was never meant to be a hero. Despite zero stats across the board and a power she can’t even use, she somehow finds herself included in a party of heroes. But Flum’s life hits rock bottom when the party’s renowned sage, Jean Inteige, decides that the useless girl is dead weight, and arranges to have her sold into slavery. Tossed to monsters to be feasted upon for her master’s entertainment, Flum makes the desperate choice to reach for a cursed weapon…and something new awakens within her. A grimdark tale about one woman’s blood-soaked quest to reclaim her life!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.romaji: "Omae Gotoki ga Maou ni Kateru to Omou na" to Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou Sareta node, Outo de Kimama ni Kurashitai

107101.description:
"It's so obvious that we can listen music for free, but all music losing its value. ─"

The near future. Drinking into the wave of progressive data conversion and flattening, digital music has been losing value, On the other hand, "live artists" expressing realistic music were reevaluated and became the admiration of many people.

Revolution to Live, Known as "LiveRevolt". In such a world, Girls struggle to win peaks at the live artist training school "Kanadegaoka Girls School". This is a story of the girls who aimed at the top of the live artists and fought with songs as the sword.

107102.description:
Takeru and Seiichirou are childhood friends. They grew apart over the years but have recently been meeting each other again. Takeru enjoys hanging out with Seiichirou just like when they were kids, but he learns that the same person has become infamous for being a huge playboy. He's perplexed, but more so when Seiichirou kissed and confessed to him while drunk.

(Source: nan-chatte)

107104.description:
This is the tale of a protagonist who was summoned to protect the demon king from the hero.

Kuroki was suddenly summoned to another world. The one who summoned him was the demon king, Modes. And, the territory currently ruled by the demon king was on the verge of destruction because of the hero.

The demon king Modes, possessing an atrocious appearance, bows toward Kuroki.

「PLEASE SAVE US, SAVIOR-DONO！！」

Kuroki then decides to save the demon king due to some turn of events.

title.native: 暗黒騎士物語 勇者を倒すために魔王に召喚されました
title.romaji: Ankoku Kishi Monogatari: Yuusha wo Taosu Tameni Maou ni Shoukansaremashita

107105.description:
Turbulent times are coming to an end, but women must continue fighting. Ran Hattori fled her wedding to live as a shinobi rather than as a wife. Meanwhile, Takechiyo, who will be known as Iemitsu Tokugawa, is shunned by his mother, and someone is plotting to assassinate him. Within Edo Castle, amid a fierce battle for succession, the two—never meant to meet—begin to develop feelings that go beyond those of master and servant.

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

107106.description: While the family business bankrupted overnight and her boyfriend cheated at the same time, anger made her reach for the bottle. Hopelessly drunk, she forced someone she just met less than 3 days ago to marry her! Luckily, he is not so bad-looking and very nice - but he lied about his identity! He claimed that he was an assistant, but who knew that he was actually a billionaire! (Source: WebComics)

107107.description:
There is a dead body town (Graveyard) where all corpses from around the world gather. On the outskirts of the city there is a stranger's dead body, the scholar Karon, and a laboratory with the motto of ghastly grave protection. A woman brings a tearing brother's dead body to the corpse street... and so a dark fantasy tale over the secret of a strange corpse begins.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

Bonus Track. Co-op Tanaka no Manatsubi - (コーポ田中の真夏日)

(Source: natalie.mu)

107109.description: Small stories set in a small town.

107111.description:
It's August 15th, the season of the Bon Festival. Aki likes this time of year because she can see the spirits of everyone's ancestors that come back home, and wishes that it could stay like this forever. However, her wish comes true as the same day begins to repeat over and over. She works together with a mysterious young man named Natsuo, the only other person in town who notices the days repeating, in order to find out what's going on, and how to return things back to normal.

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)

107112.description:
Saint Cecilia is beloved by the townspeople—not only is she elegant and composed, she benevolently shares her wisdom with all who seek it. That is, until the last person has left—at which point she becomes totally hopeless! Only Pastor Lawrence, is keeping the Saint put together enough to do her duties...and though she may test him, it's all in a day's work!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

107114.description:
A cosmic disaster changed the Earth forever, stripping away every last drop of color from the world. Mankind also changed: the familiar human face is almost forgotten in a world now populated wholly by mutants. Against the backdrop of a moody urban landscape, a lone wolf investigator named Avidia relies on both his wits and extraordinary gun to hunt down the world’s last hidden scraps of color. He soon crosses paths with a very special girl–one who just might hold the key to bringing back what the world has lost.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

107115.description: A manga editor at a publisher is truck'd into a new world and works as a publisher in his new world.

title.native: 異世界出版の編集さん

107116.description:
In the not-so-distant future, Japan continues to make extraordinary discoveries and advancements, including the ability to print your own companion! With a bio-printer, anyone can have the critter of their dreams. Well, assuming it prints correctly, that is. Unfortunately for Sato, while trying to print a Shiba Inu, an error results in a totally different creature—one that has never been seen before! Sato has no idea what he’s created or how to care for it, but despite the oddities, he’s endeared by the squishy and soft cutie. Even his friend is charmed by the odd, loaf-shaped pet and gives it the perfect name: Mochimochi!

But when Sato learns that there are others like Mochi, their social circle begins to grow–leaving them with more questions about this peculiar printed pal.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Thirteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category

title.native: プリンタニア・ニッポン

107118.description:
We’re creatures that forget all about the summer heat as soon as it’s winter.

Before the falling snow covers everything in white…
Before the summer comes and melts it all away…
Someday, our scars will become just another funny story…
And, sooner or later, the day will come when we’ve forgotten about it all.

(Source: http://to-ti.in/product/yukigafutteuresii)

title.native: うっかり寝過ごして月へ / replicable anxiety

107120.description:
Banaza, a humble merchant, is summoned to another world as a hero candidate, in the hopes that he has what it takes to defeat the demon army. When his summoners discover that he possesses no special skills, Banaza is summarily dismissed…but something goes wrong, and he can’t go back home. Now he must find a way to survive in this new kingdom. Luckily, Banaza might be more powerful than anyone–including Banaza himself–realized!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

107121.description:
The Magical Kingdom of Klyrode summons hundreds of heroes from other worlds every year to fight in their war against the Dark One and his army of powerful demons. Banaza is one of those heroes, summoned from the Royal Capital Paluma, but something’s not right—Banaza is only an average merchant. He has no magic, no fighting ability, and his stats are abysmal. Worse, a mishap leaves him unable to return home! Rejected as a hero and stranded in another world, abandoned to the far reaches of the kingdom by a cruel king who just wants him gone, Banaza’s fate looks pretty bleak. But what will happen once the failed hero candidate finds himself with super cheat powers once he hits level two?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

107128.description:
“MY ONLY CRIME WAS LOVING YOU…” Aristia la Monique was the child of prophecy, raised to be the companion of the future emperor-until she wasn’t. When the actual child of prophecy appears on the palace grounds, Aristia is immediately cast aside by both fiancé and country and forced to watch as Jieun is handed the love, future, and throne that was supposed to be hers. Her only reward for a lifetime of obedience is death…or rather, a second chance at life! When she unexpectedly wakes up in her ten-year-old body, Aristia resolves to escape the shackles of prophecy no matter the odds. This time, she’ll take fate into her own hands!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Aristia la Monique – Die gefallene Kaiserin

107129.description:
For the most part, Wisdaregidor is your typical fantasy world: monsters wreaking havoc, taverns packed with gung-ho adventurers, and a demon overlord looking to rule it all. But Wisdaregidor has one thing you’ll never find in Middle-earth: the Internet! Zane and Kuku are two adventurers trying to build a fanbase. The pair will do whatever it takes to get more subscribers for their streamed videos, even if it means taking on the demon lord himself!

Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra chapters.

107134.description:
It’s springtime at Kimberly Magic Academy, and that means the arrival of a fresh crop of first-year students. Whether it’s the quiet and studious Oliver Horn or Nanao Hibiya, a samurai girl from a distant land, they come with wands and swords at their waists, ready to take their first steps on the road to magical mastery. However, beneath its brilliant facade of cherry blossoms, the academy hides countless dangers and dark secrets, ready to take the lives of the unprepared…!

(Source: Yen Press)

107135.description:
Springtime at Kimberly Magic Academy, when new students begin their first year. One boy, clad in black robes with a white cane and sword strapped to his hip, approaches the prestigious school. This young man--Oliver--must form a bond with a katana-wielding girl named Nanao if he's to survive the dangers he's to face at this school that is anything but what it seems!

(Source: Yen Press)

107137.description:
The poisonous spider lady is beautiful and elegant, but cruel. A young man asks for her, hoping she can give him her poisonous silk. He wishes to use the lace as a hair band for his stepmother's gift, as he hates his stepmother and wants to poison her. Can Mrs. Spider see it, is that true?!

(Source: Buka, translated)

107139.description: The story follows Ryuuto Hende, a soldier with unbelievable luck who was assigned to the province where a succubus is drying out men to death, and the local "first lady", who happens to be sexually frustrated. The H-parts show mostly a big-breasts theme and mutual love/appreciation.

107140.description:
A week after Emu Ikariya's father died, a debt collector showed up on his doorstep. His late father left behind a debt of $40,000. Now, Emu has to pay up.

Emu grew up poor. He's not particularly fond of smiling or other people. No one understands him and all he's ever known is bad luck. There's no way Emu has the money to pay back his father's debts. That's when the debt collector suggests he sell his body at a secret gay club. Just then, a high school classmate of Emu's named Nenji Fukutomi appears out of nowhere and proclaims, "I'll buy Ikariya!" What on earth is he talking about?!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

107143.description:
Hyeon was supposed to spend his Christmas snuggling with his cat on his comfy couch watching TV. This year, however, he decides to attend his company holiday party to make his existence known to his office crush—the devilishly handsome Alek—but instead, downs too many drinks, makes a fool of himself, and blacks out. The morning after, he wakes up to a Christmas nightmare: lying next to him butt naked is his despicable colleague, Ivan Mariani. Hyeon has always hated everything about Ivan. So why does Ivan suddenly look different...smell wonderful...and radiate irresistible sexual energy?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a 5-chapter long side story

107144.description:
The one feared by all, "Criminal King Poponepo," has been arrested, but he immediately escapes prison. During his escape, he abducts the main character, Maruki, and implants the IC chip that identifies Poponepo as a criminal into Maruki. Now, Maruki is being arrested as the new "Criminal King." Will Maruki be able to live up to the notoriety of the Criminal King

(Source: MangaHelpers)

Our favorite characters have moved on to college and are all pursuing the new goals that they have set for themselves. Far away in Austria, Tsukimori continues to keep in touch with Kahoko while steadily expanding his violin techniques. Comparing herself to the rest, Kahoko finds herself in distress! Will she be able to follow her heart and discover her own path as well?

title.native: 金色のコルダ 大学生編

107149.description:
From an award winning web-novel of the same name. Cheering on her friend's crush, using abusive language towards the homeroom teacher. Suzumina's fun school life changes greatly after one incident. The one who saved Suzumina, who was deeply hurt was her homeroom teacher, Miyazuki-sensei. The forbidden love between a Japanese teacher and a lonely high school girl!

(Source: Chibi Manga)

107150.description: Sennoki Kentarou thinks of himself as a would-be novelist but is actually a NEET living at an old house belonging to his family in Tokyo. By refusing to visit his grandparents' village to participate in a festival he angers a certain Shinto deity.

107152.description: Former High School friends turned roommates, Ah-Young Jing and University arts student Nara Kwon have developed a close yet ambiguous relationship. What course will their desires and uncertainties take after Ah-Young Jing asks Nara Kwon about "Friendship Night"?

107157.description:
After being worked quite literally to death, corporate slave Routa Okami's dying wish is to be reborn as the well-loved pet of a rich family. When a compassionate goddess actually grants his wish, Routa commits himself to the lazy, carefree, all-you-can-nap lifestyle of a pampered pup-complete with a beautiful owner and all the delicious food he can eat! But as Routa grows...and grows...and grows...he realizes something is terribly wrong. With his enormous body, razor-sharp teeth, and fierce visage, it's painfully obvious that he was reincarnated not as a dog but as a giant wolf. And not just any wolf-the legendary wolf king Fenrir!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 prologue, 7 epilogue and 1 bonus chapter.

Hinata, rejected by his own parents and classmates, tries to find his own place in the world.

(Source: Shotachan Translations)

107169.description:
Suga's so-called "part time work" is how he survives, stealing men's wallets from hotels. Having lured yet another gay lover, Suga loses the advantage when he's doped and becomes aroused in a hazy fog of consciousness.

(Source: DLsite)

107172.description:
In Osaka in the year "AD20XX," Hand Shakers are partners who can summon "Nimrodes," weapons born from their deep psyche by joining hands. In order to grant the pair's wish, the Hand Shakers compete with and fight other Hand Shaker pairs. The top pair will then meet and challenge "God."

(Source: Anime News Network)

107173.description:
The "board game manga" is about a speed-running solo gamer and a girl who loves board games.

Sayaka Kiryuu is a model student, but rumors are going around that she is hanging out with adults. Her classmate Takuya Takatsuki ends up going with her one day, and finds out that what she does with adults is board games.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 遊びたがりの霧生さん

107180.description:
The manga centers on Hayabusa, a girl who is actually a god. The story begins when Hayabusa is looking intently at a man eating croquettes in a park. When the man gives her a croquette, she sprouts mechanical wings and flies away. When the man returns the next day, Hayabusa is there to thank him and offers him a ride in the sky, for which she turns into a Ki-43 Hayabusa fighter plane to do so.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 隼ちゃんもとんでます

107181.description:
Without a place where we belong, us runaways are like lost ships searching for a harbor...
These 4 children all completely different in personality, Graham, Angie, Max, and Sarnin all left their homes and parents and started traveling together. Is there anyone who can help them heal from their painful pasts? As they travel far and wide for the love they never received, the bonds they forge run thicker than blood.

107182.description:
In London of 1882, an injured woman safeguarding a powerful ring is fleeing a dangerous organization. The ring is pickpocketed by a local thief gang, and she passes out from her injuries before being able to recover it. When she awakes, she finds that the young thief gang has taken care of her, and a boy named Sari, who has no memories of his life before the gang took him in five years ago, has the ring.

When the organization tracks them down, he wears the ring and unleashes its power. However, he can't take it back off. Now the woman wants him to come back with her to her organization. Will he uncover the secrets of his past?

107183.description:

Aisya, a young girl living in an orphanage, possesses a mysterious power: when she paints with her own blood, the resulting paintings cause miracles. Yet the works born of her goodwill become tainted by human greed, and in time they begin to harm people. They have come to be known as “The Witch’s Cursed Paintings.” Aisya entrusts her final wish to her dearest friend—Loki, whom she herself had painted—and asks him to burn all of her creations. Bearing that heavy promise upon his shoulders, Loki sets out on a far-reaching journey!

Shirasu is an avid follower of fan culture, spending hours scrolling through his social media tags, looking at art created by his fans, and obsessing over reading fanfiction. After spending so much time engaging with the desires of the drama's most enthusiastic demographic, Shirasu has become rather strict with Maeda about his expectations—he needs to give fans what they want.

And as he watches some other guy cuddle up with Hirose like casual bros, Nakamura tries to keep his head from exploding. Why can’t that be him?! He’ll do anything to save them, but can he? Or is he too late?

Legend says there lives a crow who could speak... but the legend never mentioned how much this crow loves to eat human food?! Karasuma "Karasu" descends to the world of humans and is driven by his longing to eat good food - he even picks up a part-time job to pay for his food cravings. Karasuma, in his human form, visits restaurants, cafes, and eateries all around Kyoto and falls in love over and over with all the different meals and dishes he encounters. There, in his vanished mother's hometown, he hopes to find a clue to her whereabouts and to meet the mysterious smiling girl from his dreams. But life only gets harder for this zoophobe when he's invited to join a secret organization that seeks to coexist with fantastical beasts and protect the world from the ones that go out of control. 107305.description:
Elf? Dwarf? No! Humans are the strongest! I was summoned to a different world where humans are the strongest living beings. In my previous world I was just a normal everyday salaryman, but in this new world, I seem to have become a rare existence. I, who have obtained the strongest power through my race, have decided to enjoy this seemingly stress-free life to the fullest.

Takatou Shinobu, brother-lover, 25 years old.
Living under the same roof are his older brother, Masaki, and nephew, Kazuomi.
Kazuomi is a troublemaker who is suspicious about Shinobu's familial love for his father, and always bullies Shinobu when Masaki isn't around. And to top it off, he even does something like that…!
Because they are "family," there are many feelings they cannot communicate.

107309.description:
In the end of the 18th century in Russia, Count Lef Fyodor and his wife, Anna, great opera singer, were shot to death because Count Fyodor protested against the tzar. Their daughter Rosalinda grows up as a farmer couple's daughter.

Rosalinda is discovered as the daughter of count Fyodor by the cossack Adrian and she eventually departs for Saint Petersburg, where the tzar is being threatened by a group whose leader is called "Black Hawk".

107310.description: Kujou Akito, rich-smart-scary guy who's actually an otaku, caught by his friend, Takaya Jin, bought an anime figure and took his pictures. Takaya then asked to Akito to be with him for 5 days, and he said "I know about you more than you know about me".

107311.description: Japan in the sixties, Sumire, a twenty-year-old woman, works as a saleswoman in a department store. She refuses to depend on a man to live and sees her own body as a weapon to create herself a place in society. A contract to guarantee her freedom, to fight against this machismo that hinders women. But can one protect oneself from human nature and one's own feelings?

107312.description:
30 year-old Kazushi is an insomniac who suffers from Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder. Plagued with terrible nightmares that neither medication nor therapy have been able to alleviate, the perpetually exhausted man has become terrified of sleep. When his coworker Wabuka learns of his condition after he passes out at work one day, the gentle man holds Kazushi's hand and uses his deep, melodious voice to lull him into a peaceful, nightmare-free slumber. The next morning, Wabuka suggests that they live together so that he can help Kazushi sleep at night, and the two men begin an unusual form of cohabitation. Adult male work colleagues sleeping belly-to-belly as if they were lovers is undoubtedly strange; but the longer it goes on, Wabuka finds Kazushi growing more and more precious to him...

(Source: Anime-Planet)

107314.description:
"Then just kill me."

Akihiko has never known his true worth. Ever since he was a child, no one has ever needed him. On the verge of giving up on life, he's saved from certain death by Kazushige, a vampire who's doomed to an eternity of loneliness. To repay Kazushige, Akihiko continues to visit him, much to Kazushige's chagrin. Fed up, Kazushige drives him away. But he soon realizes that Akihiko's awkward kindness has touched a part of him that now yearns to learn more about Akihiko.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

107315.description: In early summer, 2nd year of high school, Koguma's mom suddenly leaves, leaving only a note that says "Bye." She is alone, having no parents, no friends, no hobbies. She silently reflects, "I don't have anything." But a chance encounter results in her buying a Honda Super Cub with a disturbing history, and a new life suddenly blossoms open.

107316.description: The story of a traveling blind girl who plays the shamisen and her encounter with an author who seems to always wear sunglasses wherever he goes.

107317.description:
A loving wife, a beautiful daughter, trust and a high social position I built for myself… For a man who lived his life so seriously to lose it all, a pitfall of temptation must open up right in front of him! In front of the moral meticulous Makoto (Mr. M), appears the daughter of his first love! Saya persistently seduces Makoto... but why?! No one can stop this beautiful devil!

(Source: Nihon Bungeisha, translated)

107318.description:
Born at the end of the 15th century in Italy during the Renaissance, Raffaello is regarded as the greatest painter of his period. Born in Urbino, he lived in Florence, met with Michelangelo and Leonardo da Vinci, and worked for the papacy at Rome.

Raffaello died at 37, yet he had a life of success, a life recounted in this manga.
synonyms: La vie de Raffaello Santi dit Raphaël

107319.description: In early summer, 2nd year of high school, Koguma's mom suddenly leaves, leaving only a note that says "Bye." She is alone, having no parents, no friends, no hobbies. She silently reflects, "I don't have anything." But a chance encounter results in her buying a Honda Super Cub with a disturbing history, and a new life suddenly blossoms open.

107320.description: A male college student meets up with tomboy childhood friend that he hasn't seen in years. She has developed into quite a lovely young woman, but despite that, much to his dismay, she has also retained most of the tomboy personality that made her a little difficult to get along with in the past.

107321.description:
Kaboku Kotani is starting high school, and he plans to do what he’s always done: go along with his friends, keep quiet, and not draw too much attention to himself. After all, it’s hard enough to get by with a stutter like his— why make things worse by standing out from the crowd? But then he sees another first-year, Hikari Wanda, dancing like no one is watching—or like she doesn’t care who sees her. It makes Kaboku wonder: Could he reach that same freedom? To find his way to Wanda, he does something he never thought he could: He joins the dance club. After all, every routine begins with a single step, right? Join Kaboku and Wanda as they freestyle their way to life and love!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

107322.description: Lou Brandel, a genius wizard with a talent for thousands of years. One day helped a beautiful aristocratic daughter, Franc and was to be assigned to “Magic Girls' Gakuen” where he acts as a teacher! Now, the “non-standard” teacher life by the strongest wizard opens!

107324.description:
Lou Brandel is a magician who possesses talents that can only be found in one person every few thousand years. One day, he saves the beautiful and noble young woman, Fran. As the principal of Magical Girls Academy, she appoints him to work there with her! His "interesting" life of being a powerful magician teacher now begins!

A world in which Korea is the global capital of combat sports. At Nam-Il High School where the best and most talented students of martial arts reside, Jiu Ji-Tae suddenly finds himself thrust into their midst despite being a total weakling.

By neutralising his physical shortcomings through jiu-jitsu, can he rise to the top of the fight classes?

107329.description:
A BL anthology focusing on the theme of love between human and monster.

Cover illustration: Hayate Kuku
1. Midori no Ude (碧の腕) by Torino Rakuda

The secret of a monster is out, so in order to cover it up, he needs to let his classmate touch him.

A diver got washed off the shore and treated by a man living alone. He took care of his wounds but there are secrets he keeps to himself.
4. Okizari no Hanayome (置き去りの花嫁) by Wakachiko
Chemical Development Laboratory, where biological weapons and human experiments were conducted illegally, got destroyed by one of the monster experiments. Now, the monster faces the last person alive in the building, but the researcher acts differently than his previous victims.

At his sisters insistence, he has to take in her dog to obedience training. There he meets Kurosawa Kanata, a police dog trainer. Soon Masayuki forgets his fear of dogs, blinded by his curiosity towards Kanata-sensei. Will the prince like office worker and the socially awkward dog trainer fall in love?

107336.description:
The story centres on Shougo, who receives a mysterious message that says "Do you remember me?" From then on, strange events begin occurring around him. He finds a red thimble, and begins to remember things in his past that he has forgotten.

(Source: AnimeNewsNetwork)

107337.description:

Nao is lonely, and she meets her fellow student Mifuyu, who says she wants to help Nao. Something seems wrong with Mifuyu, though, as she sets up Nao with various men.
4. Night Worker (ナイト・ワーカー); Feel Young 2010-12

107338.description:
Company employee Asahi, who suffered a heartbreak a year ago, met with college student Yuu, after he came to his aid when the latter lost his wallet. After numerous meetings with Yuu, Asahi was just getting comfortable with their relationship when he accidentally discovered that Yuu is the younger brother of the man he used to love. The traces of similarity made Asahi afraid of getting hurt again. He had decided to distance himself from Yuu when he suddenly received a confession.
"I don't care who you loved in the past, but from now on, please look only at me."

107347.description: Kamio has an unrequited love for Kitano, the manager of the basketball club. During the train ride home together, Kamio accidentally grabs Kitano's chest and something happens to him...

107349.description:
A little ecchi love-comedy between an apparition onee-san and a human shota-ish. Yuuki Kuwahara, decided to live alone at his father 's parent's house when he entered high school. He move there with the hope of once again meeting the person he met when he was a child. However, in the house where nobody was supposed to be living in, an unexpected welcome awaited Yuuki.

Note: Includes a bonus chapter.

107356.description:
Baby boom is a collection of stories animated by two recurring characters, a "bird" (the black-headed animal under the mask of which the author likes to imagine himself) and a "chick", engaged, in pairs or in a group, in all kinds of activities specific to childhood: hoops, cubes, swimming, folding, drawing, snacks, constructions, sandboxes, jumping in puddles...

Using two colors of felt-tip pens, Yokoyama has left his drawings with the freshness of sketches. By their (apparent) speed of execution, by their colored contrasts, his boards are in this way the obvious and communicative extension of the frenzied joy of the bird, the chick and their playmates.

107357.description: A series of short stories set in the Mob Psycho 100 universe, all done by other authors.

107359.description:
Keiko can't stop thinking about her mature classmate, J. One day, she hears a rumor that J is having a physical relationship with their homeroom teacher... The story which is a spin-off to Kaoruko Himeno's novel " Tsu, I, Ra, Ku," sensitively depicts the anxiety and irritation that every girl experiences during her teenage years.

Contains part 1-6 of Lavender Note (ラベンダー・ノート), and part 1-5 of Wonder Room (ワンダー・ルーム)

107360.description: Although Mio wanted to become good friends with Haibara-kun who transferred to her class. The first impression she received was the worst ever! But since with her grades, she was in danger of getting retained for a year, she has to go beg Haibara-kun to help tutor her?!

107362.description:
Third year fine arts student Ji Ye has been living with his teacher and lover Guan Shan for three years, but life has become boring. Their relationship has slowly turned stale, and the two start facing problems borne of anger and jealousy as Ji Ye considers breaking up and Guan Shan starts suffering from a mid-life crisis. While dealing with the opposition of their friends, their 16 year age gap, and their turbulent emotions, the two search for the true meaning of happiness.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated and edited)

107363.description:
When Kirito took on a random quest on the 76th floor to kill time, he didn't expect to be transported to a bedroom and find himself wearing pajamas. To his surprise, the One Thousand and One Nights quest summons various girls that he is acquainted with, all of whom are tricked into thinking that they have to share a bed with Kirito to complete the quest. The true goal of the quest, however, is for Kirito to survive till morning without getting into bed with them. If he fails, there will be a penalty for the girls...

(Source: Dreadful Decoding)

107365.description:
When Mayumi’s fiancé leaves her for another woman, Mayumi impulsively decides to move away and start over again by the seaside. Once there she meets Rin, a tough but kind single mother who runs the housing complex Seagull Villa. While the two women might not have a lot in common, they’re drawn to each other, and the relationship growing between them is deeper than they expected. Sail away on this tale of romance by the sea!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: chapter count includes three 4-koma extra chapters.

107366.description:
The series centers on Yuuto Kyoubashi, a light novel illustrator who has a particular fetish for navels. He meets Nonoka Nogi, a 14-year-old cosplayer, who is his fan, and she begins helping him out with his housework. The story shows Yuuto and his colleagues, which include his editor and other light novel and adult game illustrators.

(Source: Anime News Network)

107367.description:
The series centers on Yuuto Kyoubashi, a light novel illustrator who has a particular fetish for navels. He meets Nonoka Nogi, a 14-year-old cosplayer, who is his fan, and she begins helping him out with his housework. 107368.description:
Our story begins with Ji-Gyo, the crown prince, having recently been exiled from the palace with a guard, Dan-Geum, and the man who raised him, Chunggeum. The three are forced to pass their remaining days in a quiet village made up of mostly elderly residents. This leads to a listless and lonely Ji-Gyo, who begins pressing Dan-Geum to relieve his traditional post as a voiceless shadow, and the two quickly grow closer. Hints of a bloody conspiracy, Dan-Geum’s mysterious origin, and Chunggeum who seems to know more than he's letting on - just how are these three characters connected, and what will happen to them during exile?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

107373.description:
It's not worth it to have a slow and tedious love affair with just one person...
It's a shame for a man not to eat when the meal is ready!

With such a motto, Shoji is enjoying his youth as a flirtatious playboy. One day, he runs into Miyuki, a student from an all-girls' school, who says that she is looking for a boy who will have sex with her just once, no strings attached!

This is the start of a super-duper silly and happy romantic comedy!

(Source: Betsucomi, translated)

107374.description: Senior high school student Mirai is surrounded by good-looking guys. One day, a mysterious fortune teller foretold that she would marry one of 3 guys… with whom does she share the red string of destiny…??

107377.description: Witness the first appearances of the mysterious Towa Organization - a player in the Boogiepop Phantom anime series - as Boogiepop finds himself hunted by the synthetic human known only as "Spooky E." All the while, the deadly "Imaginator" is out to change the world one mind at a time. Can you escape from the clutches of the Imaginator...?

107378.description:
Take off everything and be enslaved [Tame]!! in a different world filled with fantasy!!

I accidentally died while playing a VR compatible game, and now the goddess will reincarnate me into the world of that game with specialized enslavement skill 【TAME】
Every single female opponent will be stripped with 【TAME】 and given pleasure by my hands while going forward to an adventure! ! !

107379.description: Touka is an ordinary high school girl who loves bowling. Her father runs a bowling alley, she has a crush on her former coach, and she is a pro at the game. The only issue is that if anybody watches her bowl, she becomes extremely conscientious of her body and plays poorly. To ensure this doesn't happen, Touka's best friend tries to help her overcome her shyness while bowling.

title.native: ストライク・オア・ガター

107380.description: When a mountain tiger is hunted and killed, her wounded cub Sandu takes human form and leaves the wilderness, seeking aid from the nearby village's physician, Euiseo. The doctor takes him in and treats his injuries, but his unusual new patient becomes attached to him and doesn't want to leave his side. Will the medicine man really make Sandu leave when his wounds are healed, or has the young tiger found his mate?

107381.description: A god, tired of this world. A little girl, lively but sickly. The summer they cross paths.
synonyms: The Straw Hat and the Carp

107382.description:
A collection of short stories to give your heart a hard-on Apple was the number one call boy at Fruity until a jilted client attacked his face. What future can Apple find after his fall from popularity now that he is "bruised fruit"? Crazy Fruits also contains "Crazy Fruits: Spin-off" (Call-boy manager x host) and "The House Where You Live" (40-year-old divorcee x housekeeper).

(Source: Futekiya)

107383.description: A heartwarming short story about an unemployed guy and his encounter with a lonely young man.

107385.description: Shinya owns a special shop named, Omoiro, that serves both humans and vampires known as "bats". There is a secret the shop owner has been holding for the past 10 years; it is to give blood to the man who has been his caretaker, Sunakawa Sanshirou, since the time he was a high school student. Since suddenly being attacked by a vampire while heading to a dinner, Sunakawa has became a "bat". Shinya decided the best way to stay connected to Sunakawa's is by making their relationship that of a Master & servant by giving him blood, hoping it would keep him by his side.

title.native: 餌付けは夜半、あの部屋で
title.romaji: Edzuke wa Yahan, Ano Heya de

107386.description:
Wife: Ichiko Aihara. Husband: Otoya Aihara. Married for seven years, they get along well, but sexless and without children, they agree to see other people. Otoya has an affair with Mitsuki, and Ichiko is aware of it. Looking at Otoya in a state of bliss with Mitsuki, Ichiko begins to change, too… Peko Watanabe tells a story of lies and truth — whether or not you ever want to get married, the real life of this thirty-something couple might give you some second thoughts about that institution we call marriage!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

107387.description:
A surrealist tale by the creator of neo manga, the critically-acclaimed Yuichi Yokoyama. His frenetic visual style contrasts with the taciturn pace of the story and dialogue as a group of friends wander the high-latitude areas of the strange icy Far North looking for someone. Readers of Yokoyama's other stories may even recognize some characters.

(Source: Retrofit Comics)

107389.description: Sawada Kouhei has been experiencing writers block for 72 days when he runs across a mysterious restaurant. Upon entering, he’s astonished to find a handsome man, Fukami, behind the bar. He’s even more overwhelmed when he is told that the restaurant only serves parfaits. What is such a handsome man doing making nothing but girly parfaits!?

107390.description:
It was a summer when even breathing was hard due to the heat. The air conditioner in An Kyungsoo’s room was long broken. As a replacement, his landlord sent him a humanoid air conditioner that is all the rage overseas, taking form in a handsome male model. As soon as it is turned on, it became so cool that he cuddled it, but he can’t help feeling a bit weird. As he was cuddling this temporary replacement of his AC, he pressed a button located “somewhere” and it opened it’s eyes. Turns out that not only did his humanoid have a handsome face, he also has a kind personality and a gentle voice… This totally perfect AC’s over friendliness gradually included skinship, as well as relieving his sex drive that has been long stifled by the heat…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of Kidari Entertainment's "Yeoreumdanpyeonseon: Some in Summer (~키다리이엔티 여름단편선~ 썸인썸머, Kidari Entertainment Summer Short Story Collection: Some in Summer)"

107391.description:
Natsuko is a happy child. Thanks to her father, working in the milk industry, she has a good life. But, when during a trip to Hokkaido, she crosses paths with a mysterious girl in the mist, she could discover hidden family secrets... How will it change her life ? What dramas did her mother live through ? In the span of a few months, Natsuko could grow up far quicker that she imagined...

(Source: Akata, translated)

107392.description:
A human, lycan, or a vampire - what am I?! Completely unaware of the existence of these predators, Hwa-Gok goes about his everyday life... That is, until Lee-Bin turns his life upside down by biting him on the neck, setting off a whirlwind of events neither of them could foresee.

(Source: Lezhin US)

107393.description:
Mr. Do-Yun Kim’s a pretty quiet, unassuming guy at the office with a big secret. He’s actually half vampire! But without full vamp status, he can’t drink blood and has to seek out some human essence to live. Drained and desperate, he finds a “special” companion, but everything goes wrong. Now he’s caught up in a one-sided office relationship, and most importantly, it’s not working!!! Will Do-Yun survive and keep his secret intact?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

107394.description:
Gong U-Jin is a passionate salesman at Bubble Doll, a doll toy company for girls! You fell in love with a married man with a child you met by chance? Gong U-Jin and Lee Do-Hyeon's relationship develops due to successive coincidences.

① A married man
② The father of a child
③ A lot older
④ Straight, maybe?

Even though he can see the mountain he has to overcome, U-Jin can't control himself, he's still attracted to Lee Do-Hyeon... What will this couple's fate be?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

107395.description: What is the common point between a cat who thinks she's a pin-up, a jealous killer pigeon (straight out of a Hitchcock movie!), a psycho-rigid mother-in-law, a monstrous handsome greenish kid, and a failed team of marquetry specialist? None, except they are the heroes of this 100% gags manga...

107396.description: A single parent and salary man, Atsushi, met his neighbour Hiiro through strange circumstances. He is concerned about beautiful, but also somewhat lonely Hiiro, yet he was told "You've heard of vampires, right? Don't get close to me...". Even so, Atsushi can't leave him alone and makes a proposition...?!

107397.description: Kang Woong, who managed to get a job at a Psychological counseling center, is curious about Do Young whom he met there. Do Young, the man who seems to forget everything, and always comes back to the center as if it’s his first time. Until Kang Woong’s feelings of curiosity starts to turn into something else…

107398.description:
Yogurt is an Alpha, and Cookie is an Omega who just moved to be Yogurt’s neighbor. Out of curiosity, Cookie wanted to find his brother, and was harassed by other Alphas on the street. Luckily Yogurt arrived in time and helped him, which, as a result, made them closer. What will happen next between them?

(Source: WebComics)

107400.description: For some reason a collegian Maru needs a new place to stay and ends living with his friend’s bro, a novelist Yohan who complains about his late​ insomnia and asks Maru to help him fall asleep. Guess what happens next?

107401.description:
Vampires in this world are not like the ones from the movies. Sunlight doesn't affect them, they are not afraid of garlic, and they do not have superhuman abilities. But one element does remain true: vampires need to drink blood to survive. When Yohsuke is orphaned after a tragic accident, he is taken in by Naruichi's parents. A family of vampires, naturally, they all believed that one day Yohsuke would also awaken to his vampire self, just as Naruichi did. And just as anticipated, Yohsuke goes through a transformation... but what awaited him on the other side weren't the fangs of a vampire...!

(Source: Futekiya)

107402.description: The origin of Boogiepop revealed at last. Not only is this the long-awaited story of how Boogiepop was born, but it is also the tale of four very strange individuals: a detective, an eater of fear, a popular writer and a skilled assassin. Uncover all the secrets.

title.native: 夜明けのブギーポップ

107403.description: A genius artistic talent, Katsuragi Mayu, transfers to the all-girls Kiyomi High. Her figures are grotesque and erotic, with a unique world view that no one has seen before. But she says, "You can only draw what you've seen".

107404.description:
Madness prevails in this hardboiled noir story set in the proletariat bars and living areas of Tokyo.

(Source: Black Hook Press)

synonyms: 河童の居る川 (つげ忠男漫画傑作集 2)

107406.description:
"One million for one night. Who will?" "Ten million for one night!" Feng Lingye, a powerful man in the capital, had his eye on her. She could do nothing but retreating one step after another in face of his aggressiveness... However, a sudden car crash led out a huge conspiracy... She brought her two cute and talented kids back six years later in an attempt to find out everything, but she met him again.

(Source: Mangatoon)
synonyms: Embarassed To Be Kissed By The President
Les baises du président qui me font baisser les yeux

title.romaji: Zongcai Yi Wen Hao Xiu Xiu

107408.description:
She was forced to sell her body to save her ill mother. In the end, she still lost her mom. Just when she was immersed in grief and pain, she discovered that she was accidentally pregnant. She had to work in the entertainment industry to survive but she ran into the father of her child...who is the CEO of the company?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

107409.description:
I recalled memories of my past life after Grandfather told me my engagement was annulled. At the same time, I realized this world was the same world as in my favorite shoujo manga. The villainess who exhausted every method possible to bully the heroine… I reincarnated as that villainess’ chubby follower. I shook upon remembering the future lined up for her. When the villainess’ evil deeds came to light, she pinned all her crimes on Britney. I was a character that gets executed.

To reliably avoid this, I must not become the villainess’ follower. As this villainess only keeps those who are exceptionally uglier than her by her side, I may be able to do something if I slim up. For now, let’s go on a diet!
synonyms: Tenseisaki ga Shoujo Manga no Shirobuta Reijou datta

title.native: 転生先が少女漫画の白豚令嬢だった
title.romaji: Tensei-saki ga Shoujo Manga no Shirobuta Reijou datta

107410.description:
Collection of four sci-fi/fantasy stories:
1. Raryou Ou (羅陵王); Lala 1985-12
2. Aleph (アレフ); Grape Fruit 1985-08
3. Taopi (タオピ); Petit Flower 1987-11
4. Emerald Garden (緑玉庭園); Laksmi 1987-08

107411.description:
High school boy Tsubasa moves to Kitami City up in Hokkaido, where he meets a "gal" at a bus stop. The sight of her standing alone against the white snowscape, bare-legged despite the freezing cold, captures his heart.

(Source: Manga Plus)

Note: Referred to as Chapter 0 in the serialized version.
synonyms: Esa gal de Hokkaido es demasiado linda

title.native: 道産子ギャルはなまらめんこい

107412.description:
Ayame is 25 years old. She lost her father fifteen years ago, and is now in search of the pub that she had frequented with him when she was a child. Night after night, she stops at pubs on her way home from work, and on one particular night, she happens to meet a man who might be able to help her find what she's missing...

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

107413.description:
Momo and Kairi are at the peak of their relationship, but still not married?! The pressure is on! Sae can’t stand to see this couple happy, and she won’t stand for it! Touji also seems to already have a shadow hanging in his past after becoming an adult … What happened? Get ready for this love train to move full-steam ahead once again!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

107414.description:
While protecting his grandson from a burglar, Seitaro Asao, a tea plantation owner, gets stabbed to death. A slight mix-up by a goddess gets him, instead of his grandson, accidentally summoned to another world. Seitaro accepts to take his grandson's place and starts his new life in the new world as a man ten years younger. Things are quite eventful from the start, but the gods work in mysterious ways, and wisdom and protection from the goddess helps him overcome all obstacles.

(Source: Alpha Manga)

107415.description: The story centres on 73-year-old Seitarou Asao, who runs a tea plantation. Due to a god's mistake, he gets transported to another world in the place of his grandchild. He then starts a second life 10 years younger as 63-year-old Seitarou. Through his wisdom of an old man and "assistance magic," he is able to live a leisurely life in his new home.

107416.description: Sajou and Kusakabe keep their promise of getting married by buying each other rings.

title.native: 同級生 限定小冊子【gold ring】 & 【silver ring】

107417.description:
A collection of short stories:

1-6. Horobi Club
7. Usagi no Frau
8. Happy Days
9-13. Kiri no Iitokoro de.

title.native: ホロビクラブ ~クール教信者短編集~

107419.description:
1. Exception!

i 3. Souiu Kibun
