107421.description: Set 25 years after the original series, centered around a 42-year-old Sagawa.
synonyms: Kyou Kara Ore Wa!!: Sagawa the Hero & Those Two

title.native: 今日から俺は!!～勇者サガワとあの二人編～
title.romaji: Kyou kara Ore wa!! Yuusha Sagawa to Ano Futari-hen

107422.description: A spin-off about Nakane, who is now a normal working adult. Dissatisfied with his newly restrictive and tedious life, he becomes interested in getting "likes" on social media.
synonyms: Legend of a Strongest Man Nakane

107423.description: A new big beautiful guy is transferred in Hoshino's class. Wait! He's Ichinose, the troublemaker of middle school. At that time Hoshino has written a love novel between Ichinose and his new stepbrother. When the novel was discovered by a classmate, they make fun of them and triggered Ichinose's wrath. Then ichinose transferred. Maybe was Hoshino's fault? And now he's back!

title.native: 市ノ瀬兄弟はガマンできない

107424.description: From the time he was very young, Shuuta longed to be "married" through adoption to Kouhei. While Kouhei as a guardian was too absentminded, Shuuta always felt as if he never fulfilled his duties as a "wife". It's a love story between an airheaded, thick-skinned, handsome "husband" and an innocent, pure-hearted new "wife" with an age gap!

107425.description:
Cover Illustration: Ranmaru Zaria
1. Lala no Kekkon (ララの結婚) [Tamekou]
2. Nemuri Otoko to Koi Otoko (眠り男と恋男) [Ranmaru Zaria]
Royce is feeling awkward and shy in his budding relationship with Jude, but a pep talk from his bartender gets him back on track.

3. Caste Heaven (カーストヘヴン) [Chise Ogawa]
4. Doushite Sensei ni Natta no (どうして先生になったの) [Shundei]
Hajime is delighted to realize that his new student teacher is Souta-kun, the oniisan who used to play with him when he was little. But will their relationship always be so innocent?

5. Heart no choker (ハートのchoker) [Ataru Yamamoto]
6. Mesuiki♥︎Kenkoushinda (雌イキ♥健康診断!!) [Dan]
7. Fashion F (ファッションエフ) [Usachiko Matsuda]
8. Sense of loyalty [Yoh Matsumoto]
9. Josou Shitara Ikemen Yuujin-tachi ni Oishiku Itadaka Remashita. (女装したらイケメン友人たちにおいしくいただかれました。) [Story: Bunge Maruki, Illustration: Rikaco Kasai]
10. Control (コントロール) [Heaven]
11. Teikoku no Kangan: Migi gen Ouji Denka no Yometori (帝國の宦官 -右弦皇子殿下の嫁取り-) [Akira Hino]
synonyms: Josou Shitara Ikemen Yuujin-tachi ni Oishiku Itadaka Remashita.

107426.description:
A story of an otaku girl who is addicted to otome games, and a junior high boy who looks like her favorite character in the otome game.

Note: Includes an extra.
synonyms: Wotaku Girl and High School Boy
Otaku Girl and High School Boy

107427.description:
After his father remarries, Jaeun must now live under the same roof with his new stepbrother Jihan. However, life isn't easy when their abusive Alpha father is hellbent on controlling their lives. Things only get worse when Jaeun is revealed to be an Omega. Abandoned by his family and friends, Jaeun realizes he only has Jihan to depend on. Now as adults and living together, will this bond withstand the heat of an Omega?

(Source: Tappytoon)

107428.description:
Friends since high school, Ye Shen and Lin Xiangyao’s relationship started out like any other. Friends, just friends…until they started secretly seeing each other. Now adults, Ye can’t help but feel his relationship with Lin is shallow. Ye is an accomplished designer, Lin is a wealthy CEO. They have sex but never kiss, never make love. When Ye tries to get closer, communicate, Lin pulls away. Is a fragile lie that lasts forever the same as the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

107429.description:
Wei Qiuyu is seen as a calm and reliable executive, but he is keeping his gay sexuality a secret. At the behest of his mother, he gets into a blind date with a woman, but meets Fu Yicheng instead. Though Qiuyu finds Yicheng an annoyance, he can't help but be drawn to him every time they meet.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: The Story of a 30-Year-Old Gay Bachelor

title.english: The Secret Tales of a 30-Year-Old Gay Bachelor

107430.description:
Gaon is a boy who turned into a vampire, having inherited the condition from his mother. He discovered that his one and only friend, Dong-yi, like his older brother. Gaon loses all control when he smells the scent of blood. Aware of his instability, he asked Dongyi for his help in order to safely graduate college, and in return promised to help him get closer to his brother. However, to the contrary of his plans, the possessive, cold-hearted Yohan came to take an interest in Dongyi, and the budding relationship between the two is slowly starting to get on Gaon's nerves.

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

107431.description: When a person dies, their soul leaves the body in the form of a butterfly. It's the Death Bureau's battle to protect them...

title.native: 特蝶 死局特殊蝶犯罪対策室
title.romaji: Toku Chou: Shikyoku Tokushu Chou Hanzai Taisakushitsu

107432.description:
A young Taoist who claims to be Mr. Taoist shows up at an ordinary man's house. He is actually the God of Mountain, who cadging meals and drinks and making it as his own place. He keeps on pushing too far​ but feels boring at the same time... While the ordinary man is a SOHO who's engaged in drawing horny pictures, but something seems to be hidden in his body...

(Source: Manga Toon)

title.romaji: Jiali Laile Wei Dao Chang Daren

107433.description:
A collection of four stories serialized in the magazine Young Rose:
1. Aoi Katai Shibui (青い固い渋い); 1993-12
2. 8-gatsu ni Umareru Kodomo (8月に生まれる子供); 1994-07
3. Lost House (ロストハウス); 1994-04
4-5. Crazy Garden (クレイジーガーデン); 1994-11, 1995-02

107434.description:
I must conquer you, woman! The wise and cruel prince was about to have sex for the first time. This is a story of a time-traveling agent and an awakening genius. ​It is also a story of a horny prince and a tricky princess.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.english: The Prince Wants to Consummate: The Seduction of the Consort

107435.description:
He was raped by a woman in a blind date by accident. Who is he? He is a young man from a powerful family in the capital, attractive to young ladies but leading an honest and clean life. Who is she? She is a disfavored daughter in a wealthy family. He said to her, "Marry me and the marriage is your best protection." She said, "Neither will I be used by you, nor will love you." He smiled, "But I love you indeed."

(Source: MangaToon)

107436.description:
Cecilia Lin is a junior college​ student... and also a variety show actress. One day, the new Yama from the Underworld suddenly rushed in her life, not only to tell her she is his designated wife, but also...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Cute Yama Rushed In My Life

107437.description:
Rannosuke Hanayagi, under the cover of a renowned ikebana school, leads an empire of lust and cruelty. He is a sadist who consumes girls like he consumes cigarette, torturing and humiliating them. Offering his sex-slaves to numerous bigwigs, he then controls both the political and economical world.

On day he starts the training of a new girl, Sayuri, with the hope to make her the queen of his empire.

107438.description: Akasaka Mikke is a young artist working day and night to achieve his dream of becoming a mangaka. Things are somewhat complicated by his editor, Ubugami Ariko, who is known in mangaka circles as the "grim reaper" because every series she works on ends up getting axed. But to the surprise of many, Akasaka doesn't seem troubled by her reputation and even has a soft spot for the so-called deathbringer.

107439.description:
Gun Frontier: Harlock & Tochirou Seishun no Tabi is set on a wasteland planet and centers on quick-draw Herlock, and his close friend who always wields a samurai sword, Tochirou, as they journey across the land. The story begins when they meet a girl named Sinunora.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Gun Frontier: Harlock & Tochirou's Youthful Journey

title.native: ガンフロンティア～ハーロック＆トチロー青春の旅～
title.romaji: Gun Frontier: Harlock & Tochirou Seishun no Tabi

synonyms: Galaxy Express 999 Another Story: Ultimate Journey

title.native: 銀河鉄道999–Another Story–アルティメットジャーニー
title.romaji: Ginga Tetsudou 999 Another Story: Ultimate Journey

107442.description:
Mui-kun always had the animal magnetism... with animals. Unfortunately, it never worked with girls until his childhood friend Yuzuriha suddenly begin to take on various animal aspects, starting when she was offering a dance to the mountain spirit as a resident shrine maiden . Now she involuntarily takes on the animal spirit whenever she comes across one, most of whom disdain the confinement of human clothing...

(Source: ThePaulBunyanTrophy)

107445.description:
An infamous delinquent, Kurokawa Morio meets a partially blind girl, Akaza Yukiko.

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: Yankee-kun and the White Cane Girl

title.native: ヤンキー君と白杖ガール

107446.description:
"Mitsuki Amahara is an avid gymnast in his third year of middle school, but it's not until the final middle school competition that he competes for the first time. There, he is taken aback by the stunning performance of Sakura Dogase, a member of a renowned club. What will Mitsuki do in order to get closer to his goal...?!"

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

107448.description: “Drifting is a sport!” Rin Todoroki, a natural drifting genius, just wants to put driving aside and live out a normal, comfy university life. What will happen when she is confronted by the automobile club, or “auto” for short? Students who’ve put it all on the line… their stories start here!!

107449.description:
Ryo was an average high school student until a plane he was on crashed in a frozen wasteland. Now, there’s no telling if help will come, and the surviving passengers are already fighting among themselves. Nonetheless, Ryo struggles to find a way to work together and save everyone, but could there be a secret reason for these circumstances that he’s unaware of? Written and drawn by Ai Odahara, Land Lock is a full-color survival thriller manga! Odahara, Land Lock is a full-color survival thriller manga!

(Source: Manga Plus)

107450.description:
Seven early works from Nanae Sasaya:
1. Ahondara(あほんだら); Ribon 1972-12
2. Watashi no ai shita oumu(わたしの愛したおうむ); Ribon 1974-04
3. Tegami(手紙); Ribon 1970-03
4. Sandy ga yattekita hi(サンディーがやってきた日); Margaret 1971-03
5. Sorezore no kisetsu no naka de…(それぞれの季節のなかで…); Jotomo 1976-05
6. Tenshitachi no oka(天使たちの丘); Ribon 1972-12
7. Kikyou(帰郷); Seventeen 1977-12
synonyms: Sorezore no kisetsu no naka de…

107451.description:
Yuki starts her first year of high school. As an ex-delinquent, she feels a certain culpability about her past, and it's not without a reason: she lost the mobility of her right arm. To worsen the situation, one of her classmate, Chio, is making advances to her, while she isn't even interested in love.

All she wants is to prove the "value of her life," but why? And for whom?

(Source: Akata Manga)

107452.description: Three years ago, a deal entwined their fates together. One is the daughter of a criminal, the other is the noble master of a military family. Three years later, she has found a kind man who is willing to protect and lover her for the rest of her life, but the devil commander appeared and said: Before I get sick of you, I won't allow other guys to touch you even a bit... (Source: Manga Toon)

107453.description:
Despite the fact that Kaede Takakura belongs to a mafia family, she keeps this a secret and spends her days as a busy detective in a small town. Then one day, a young handsome man joins the Takakura family, which is headed by Kaede's grandmother. His name is Shin Odagiri. Even though he's quiet, it's because he's lonely and kind that Kaede eventually falls for him completely. The two of them proceed to have a sweet, hot, and passionate relationship. But, those peaceful days are suddenly taken away when Kaede overhears a conversation between her boss and a mysterious cop at the police headquarters. She learns that someone is an undercover agent within the Takakura family and is spying on them. Who could this agent be...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Black Prince -Give Me the Beast Waiting inside You-
title.native: 黒のプリンス ～あなたの中のケダモノをください～
title.romaji: Kuro no Prince: Anata no Naka no Kedamono wo Kudasai

107454.description:
The story began with a big adventure game. He got drunk and accidentally broke into her room and left her money before leaving the next day..."Hey you pervert! What kind of person you regard me?!" "What?! You are the one who set me up in this "trap" to scheme me!"

(Source: MangaToon)

107455.description:
For some reason she was asked to leave away from him several years ago. What she doesn't know is that he's still love her. Thus a run-and-chase love game is on.

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Thieu Soai Quoc Dan Yeu Toi
จอมพลสุดหล่อแห่งชาติได้ตกหลุมรักฉัน

title.romaji: Guomin Shao Shuai Ai Shang Wo

107456.description:
"A 'craving curse' has been etched onto my body... All these naughty thoughts... I can't control them...!" Despite successfully getting into a renowned magic academy, Eme Hoshimiya's grades are plummeting. Now, she's receiving private lessons from her heartthrob of an upperclassman, Tobari Kujyou, but the mysterious curse suddenly appears in the middle of their session. All alone, the two are overtaken by desire...! The cool, studious upperclassman who never puts a toe out of line descends on her like a man possessed... How could she not be bewildered? But... her sensitive body tingles wherever his fingers and tongue go...! "So, this magic won't break until...!?"

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Feverish Magic, Curse of Love. -I Feel So Hot...-
title.native: 微熱の魔法、恋の呪い。～先輩、カラダが熱いんです…～
title.romaji: Binetsu no Mahou, Koi no Noroi.: Senpai, Karada ga Atsuin Desu...

107457.description:
Chiaki is secretly dating her younger co-worker Akira, and although they're totally in love, she can't keep up with him in the bedroom. Akira's always ready for another round straight away, and Chiaki's been losing sleep because of it... To make things worse, Chiaki's rival at the office, Shogo, discovers their relationship! He teases her, asking if she's satisfied with "quick-draw" Akira, and says he'll keep quiet about it if Chiaki can bring Shogo pleasure!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: つまり絶倫。～だめっ…またイかされちゃう…！

107458.description:
Shoma is a businessman who lives in company housing. All of a sudden Itsuki, a man who just happens to be as cute as a girl, moves in next door. Then one night, as Shoma goes to complain to his neighbor about a noise problem, a naked man and a scantily clad Itsuki rush out. Shoma, who inadvertently ends up helping Itsuki, finds out that they went to the same preschool and were childhood friends... But he doesn't have any memory of it. Shoma, who can't bring himself to say "I don't remember" suddenly gets pushed down in front of his door by Itsuki...! This is a cute little love story between an innocent businessman and a super cute guy next door!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Tonari no Bitch-kun Kari ni Nerawareteimasu

title.english: The Guy Next Door Has It Out For Me
title.native: 隣のビッチくん（仮）に狙われています

107459.description: Misaki is going to live with her fiance, Yuuto. On her first night there, she makes love in the darkness for the first time like she's always wanted! Although it's her first time, her sensitive parts are licked so gently that she twitches and jerks repeatedly in pleasure... She was so happy that her love, Yuuto, had taken her... or so she thought. It had actually been his younger brother, Haruto! After that, Haruto uses the incident to control her. Regardless of whether they're at school or at home, he demands her like a beast. He kisses her deeply as they become entwined. It feels so good that her body melts from his countless sweet and bitter caresses that touch her inside! She knows it's wrong, but she can't resist him when he holds her so gently...! (Source: Renta!)

title.english: My Boyfriend's Brother Looks So Mean, But Holds Me Gently
title.native: カレの弟は、イジワルな顔して優しく私を抱く。
title.romaji: Kare no Otouto wa, Ijiwaru na Kao shite Yasashiku Watashi wo Daku.

107460.description:
Saori finds herself at a new school after her dad gets transferred for work. She makes friends right away, and her homeroom teacher, Mr. Nakashima, is really sweet and good-looking... The only problem is she's a terrible student. After failing another test, she visits her homeroom teacher for some tutoring, but he's acting... differently than usual. That's when he grabs her by the wrist and kisses her, slowly yet confidently working his way down. "He's nothing like I thought he was! He's a jerk! And a creep!" But, ever since that day, he's been tutoring Saori after school, and even helps take care of her in the school nurse's office. "He's usually so self-centered... so why...? Why can't I stop thinking about him!?"

(Source: Renta!)

107461.description: In a seaside city, Fuuko, a young girl who likes places where she can feel the pleasant wind, joins her high school's sailboat club. Despite being a complete newbie, will she be able to compete in the tournament...? A marine sports 4koma drawn from the author's experience!

107462.description:
Yoshida Yuko was living a perfectly normal (if poverty-stricken) life, but at the age of fifteen, she suddenly sprouts demon horns and a tail! Her mother explains that she's actually a demon named Shadow Mistress Yuko, once sealed away and cursed so that her family would remain poor for generations. Now Yuko can break that very curse if she defeats Chiyoda Momo, a magical girl who goes to her school…but Momo is stronger than she is, knows how to manage magical powers, and is so freaking nice that she's actually helping Yuko out of scrapes. Yuko's too weak and uncoordinated to straight-up kill Momo, even if she wanted to, but she can't just be buddies with this generous magical girl, either–she has to break the curse on her family somehow. What's a demon girl to do?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

107463.description:
Subaru Yoshii is an anxious and socially awkward boy. Upon transferring to a new school, he meets a fellow freshman, a boy known as “Prince”! Subaru doesn’t know it yet, but a new world is waiting for him behind the stage curtain in this thrilling high school theater story!

(Source: Manga Plus)

Includes seven extra chapters.

107465.description: When they were kids, Alice and Yuri promised to marry each other when they grow up. Years later, Yuri is in for quite a surprise as he reunites with his bride-to-be.

107466.description: When the Fullmetal Knights Chevalion defeated the Death Universe, peace returned and the Chevalion members returned to their normal daily lives. 107469.description:
A blind boy, Shinobu, lives a peaceful life with the support of his kind teacher and girlfriend, Mikoto, training daily to learn the ancient martial art of self-defense known as “Mibuchi Toshujutsu”. Until one day, when all is stolen from him by a strange visitor who appears at the dojo. This man, defeating both Shinobu and his teacher, steals away Mikoto with him. Three years pass— In order to take back his girlfriend, Shinobu climbs up from the depths of despair, and finds himself at a remote island prison where only the most abominable kind of criminals are housed. There begins a battle royal, a free-for-all fight to the death with the villainous men within!!

(Source: Manga Plus)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 extras.

107470.description:
Gou Akazaki is a 26-year-old man…who happens to be a shojo manga artist. His assistant is Yuusuke Akune, who happens to be a mangaka in his own right. But when Gou accidentally finds out that Yuusuke is gay, he’s thrown for a loop—what else about his friend doesn’t he know? And when Gou is asked to draw BL, he tries to pry into Yuusuke’s experiences for inspiration…but when he is ultimately inspired by the idea of “unrequited love for Yuusuke,” can he keep his own feelings out of the mix?

(Source: Kodansha USA, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

107472.description:
The world is filled with cruel scum, ranging from petty thieves to sociopath maniacs. When a vile low-life inflicts pain and suffering on innocent victims, sometimes their anger becomes overwhelming. Whether their damage stems from romance, finance, reputation or even a death, these victims feel trapped in their own skins and lives.

Those victims who can't stand it anymore call for the mysterious woman Houjou Shiori, owner of Uramiya, the "Revenge Shop".

The Uramiya specializes in executing revenge schemes. The vengeance their customers request on their bitterly resented enemies could range from financially destroying them, to smearing their social reputation, to even taking their lives. As long as you pay a fair price, the Uramiya will guarantee you get the revenge you deserve.

107473.description: The story is set in the 15th century, during the Hundred Years' War between France and England over the succession to the French throne. Montmorency, the son of a noble, immerses himself in the studies of magic and alchemy at a royal knight training school. However, following France's crushing defeat at Agincourt, the school is dissolved. Having lost everything and now a wanted man, Montmorency, who had just become an alchemist, encounters a mysterious village girl named Jehanne.

107476.description: Enjou Shuuto's dream was always to become a detective and take down the scumbag who killed his father. As practice, he takes on the local bullies at every opportunity... only to get his butt handed to him. But what happens when rogue nanobots descend on his neighborhood, "enhancing" their hosts with deadly results? Brought to you by the tag-team of best-selling author Kurihara Showshow and Jump Rookie! award-winner Kaza Ana!

107477.description:
Shunta and Tamaki are one year apart, but they’ve kept up their friendship even as they attend different schools. Shunta loves to see his friend happy, but one day, he comes across Tamaki crying, and something fundamental changes within him, awakening sexual feelings he doesn’t know what to do with. Shunta realizes that his feelings are not right. They’re monstrous. Impure. As the two navigate high school, the lines they cross increase, leaving them to contend with Shunta’s growing feelings and Tamaki’s own desires.

(Source: SuBLime)

107478.description:
A girls comedy in which the main character, Mai, who is looking for a leisurely job, plays with field crops and wild insects while helping her farming friend, Nanako. Nanako is a kind-hearted girl and when it comes to the field and her cherished Mai, the look in her eyes changes. The series also includes a specially drawn project that turns the insects that appeared in the chapters into beautiful girls.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

In the story, Keiichi Morisato and Belldandy lived in happiness, but due to the recession, the motorcycle shop Keiichi works at faces financial difficulties. Belldandy starts to search for a job because of the situation.

107480.description: 2034, a time when the development of AI advanced greatly and the appearance of the humanoid “Totomo” has been widely accepted. Tamotsu, an ordinary office worker, loses his daughter and has half his body replaced with mechanical parts due to an accident. While trying to live earnestly with his wife, his body begins to malfunction…

107481.description:
Washed-up Tokyo detective Mikogami Keiji is investigating a series of murders where the victims have been torn apart and drained of all blood. Could these grisly new killings be related to the decade-old unsolved murder of the woman he loved? As he renews his vow to find the creature that killed her, he has no idea he’s being stalked by a silver-haired girl with secrets of her own. Quicker than you can say “vampire,” Mikogami finds himself embroiled in a frightening conspiracy with actual monsters–but he’ll do whatever it takes in his quest for revenge.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

"Please go out with me, with the intent of eventual marriage!"

"I love you, but I'm just a fan. You can't be serious!?"

As she spends time with Saki-kun every day, can Sumire avoid breaking the boundary between between idol and fan? It's a love comedy about a fan being pursued by her idol!

107485.description:
Shinichi Honda is a student with no filter for his words or his actions. A first-year high school student, he is noble and kind but as blunt as a brick, tending to speak his mind with no hesitation. Attending the same school is Mako Wakamiya, a member of the public morals committee with an incredible sense of duty. From a distance, she appears to be cool and collected, but hidden in plain sight is the fact that she is a total klutz with a maiden's heart.

The first time Shinichi and Mako lock eyes, they are each wholeheartedly caught up in their own awkward situation. The brief moment when they pass by each other only leaves them dumbstruck at the other's strange appearance.

Months later, disaster strikes when Mako, on committee duty, must confiscate an adult manga from Shinichi. Hilarity ensues as Shinichi leads Mako on a thunderous chase all over the school. As the deafening pair happen to meet up more and more often, maybe there is hope that the two can get along?

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Midori drops her wallet on her first day of high school, but her new classmate Ichijo swoops in to help. She wants to thank him, but he’s part of a tight-knit trio and none of them are ever in class! Rumor has it that they all got expelled for acting up, and studious Midori’s actually at risk of expulsion, too… In order to help support her family, she has a part-time job, which is against the school rules. When the chairman of the school board catches her leaving work, he says he’ll let it go—but only if she’s up to the task of bringing the three boys back to school. Well, why not? It’ll be a piece of cake…right?

107512.description:
"He’s the CEO?! That guy from yesterday?!!" After losing my precious puppy who’d been at my side through high school, college, and since graduation, I went to a bar to drown my sorrows by the gallon. While I was wailing with grief, the man sitting next to me cut in with a majorly nasty retort: "Why not take some pills for your dysfunctional brain and start acting your age?" Well, I don’t have to take that from some stranger!! So I returned the favor by sticking my leg out to trip him with an, "Oh, sorry. That was on purpose!" (Yeah, maybe I went too far...) Then, the next day that same guy turns up at my office and apparently he’s the company’s CEO! What’s more, he’s here looking for...me...?!?!

In an ancient world where martial artists reign supreme, Un-Seong can only watch as his master is brutally beaten to death after a false accusation of practicing forbidden demonic arts. Even after a valiant fight, he fails to kill those responsible and faces his own end. But fate has other plans… Instead of taking his last breath, he awakens as a child, training to be an elite soldier of a demonic sect. Now Un-Seong must embrace the demonic arts and harness power in his ultimate quest for revenge.

(Source: Tapas)

Known for his biting wit and rapid-fire brain cells, Yukito Ayatsuji is a detective and top-ranked skill user who possesses the ability to expose any crime. When a request to investigate a puzzling murder incident hits his desk, Ayatsuji must team up with Mizuki Tsujimura, a spunky agent sent from the Special Division, to tackle the case. Can the unlikely duo get to the bottom of this mystery?!

107521.description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again!

Before he knows it, he’s face-to-face with the god of this new world, who presents him with a list of cheat skills to choose from…but there’s a catch. It’s first come first served, and his classmates have already beaten him to the punch.

Haruka has to make do with what he can get as he navigates his way through this brave new world, all while flying solo!

In this kingdom, Ajin are considered no better than beasts. The men are sent to war, the women serve in brothels. Those who are lucky enough to live to old age spend their last years doing degrading, menial work. Boys who show signs of magical ability must serve the imperial family in the palace. Rangetsu's twin brother is sent to the palace to serve the Prince Tenyou, but he only lasts a short time before he is murdered. Rumors say his master was the one who aimed the blade, and Rangetsu decides to puts aside her femaleness in order seek revenge. After years of excelling on the battlefield, she has finally found her way to Prince Tenyou's side. But he isn't what she expected, and the webs of intrigue in the palace is more tangled and venomous than she imagined. Can Rangetsu find her vengeance before she too falls prey to palace plots, and will her inconvenient feelings for the Prince Tenyou be a hindrance or a help?

On her 16th birthday, Melissa, an apprentice at the royal castle, was hoping to be promoted to a lady-in-waiting and work alongside her favorite dragon knight, Captain Hubert, and the dragons she loved so much. However, she suddenly found out that the captain was retiring! Melissa was despondent at the loss of her goal. But the next day, the captain made her an unexpected offer. The captain was returning home to become the lord of the frontier territory where dragons roam, and he offered to take Melissa with him, to become his dragon-keeper and his lover! A fantasy love story between a hard-nosed knight and a dragon-loving lady-in-waiting!

But his target is a very close friend he made in the military academy and who he hasn't seen in ten years, Edward. Ivan can't help but wonder, how could such a compassionate man with a passion for art, become a part of the mafia? When they meet again, Edward seems to be as nice to Ivan as in the past and Ivan, facing a dilemma in his mission, is invited back to his home. But, the next day Edward's attitude completely changes and Ivan realizes that he's been kidnapped!

Dive into the frigid depth of Russia, in the heart of St. Petersburg, and discover the exciting story of two men who oppose each other! Will friendship and love be enough to overthrow fate and bring two ruthless enemies together again?

At Toto First Bank's head office, the competition is cutthroat for its elite employees. Matsuda and Kato are members of the sales department on the 21st floor. Having joined the team at the same time, Matsuda sees Kato as his ultimate rival. Whether it's in regards to their conquests with women or their reputation at work, whenever Matsuda thinks he's one-upped Kato, he ends up getting overshadowed by Kato's accomplishments, much to his chagrin.One evening in the office, Matsuda finds out his girlfriend has cheated on him, severely wounding his pride. This mysterious youth invites Tetsuta to their restaurant and listens to his troubles, which ended with him staying the night. Tetsuta hears Nagi’s singing voice and receives an electrifying impact from within his body. For the first time in his life, he wants someone else to sing the songs he composed.

What does Kouta find out about Daigo's disappearance after he chases him down...? Do the strongest partners equal the strongest couple!? 107608.description:
"I received my life to warm you up, blankets are a god too."

A boy who's really sensitive to cold, Minato, meets a mysterious girl, Kokoro, on his 15th birthday in winter. Kokoro says that she's an artifact spirit born to warm Minato's heart, and would do anything to make sure he is warm to the core! A very exciting manga with "Warming Action" with an older woman!! This age difference flirting comedy is finally here!!
synonyms: How To Warm Up Your Blanket

title.native: 毛布おねえさんの温めかた

107609.description:
Senoo Anna recently got a job at a social game company called Kami Games, which turns out to be run by actual Gods.
Sexy... a selfish idol... an alcoholic... someone who loves cute girls... various other Gods and... a black lily?
Game development begins!
synonyms: Is This What a God-Tier Game Means?

An original story based on Kadokawa's Romance Sim.

107611.description:
The 72nd Demon King, Astaroth, has been reincarnated in a strange new land with a mission to unite the world under his banner and reform its chaotic ways. As the youngest of the Demon Kings, his forces may be weaker than his rivals, but he won’t hesitate to use all the means at his disposal to achieve victory. Wielding unheard-of resourcefulness and tactics, he’ll reshape the fate of all who live under his reign!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: The Legend of Rebuilding World By Realist Demon King

title.english: The Reformation of the World as Overseen by a Realist Demon King
title.native: リアリスト魔王による聖域なき異世界改革
title.romaji: Realist Maou ni Yoru Seiiki Naki Isekai Kaikaku

107612.description:
By the will of a whimsical goddess, the seventy-second Demon King has been reincarnated to rule alongside a chaotic mixture of humans and heroes in another world. The newly minted Demon King Astaroth has been tasked with overseeing the reconstruction of this strange, new land, and as a realist, he will use rarely seen resourcefulness and tactics to reshape the fate of all who live under his reign!

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: The Legend of Rebuilding World By Realist Demon King
The Reformation of the World as Overseen by a Realist Demon King

title.romaji: Realist Maou ni Yoru Seiiki Naki Isekai Kaikaku

107613.description: Kagaya has been the basketball club manager for 2 years, yet she thinks she is hated by one of its members. What could be the reason behind it?

title.native: 岸くんはわたしが嫌い

107614.description: Amane and Madoka had been friends since middle school, but even though Amane had hidden feelings for her friend, something completely changed their lives.

Kimi wa Mada Tori Kago no Naka

107615.description: "How does it feel to have someone else touch you? It feels good, doesn't it?" The young man acts like a gentleman, but he's actually an incubus! And now he's infiltrated the mission academy as a priest, in order to get closer to Tsubaki, the noble woman who everyone calls the lady saint. His aim is to take her body... "Let's play a game," he says. Tsubaki, curious about the incubus, accepts... And so, days of his sweet seduction and twisted gazes begin. If she loses, pleasure awaits her... (Source: Renta!)

title.english: Imprisoned and Bound in a Honey Flower
title.native: がんじがらめな蜜の華に囚われて
title.romaji: Ganji Garame na Mitsu no Hana ni Torawarete

107616.description:
Niito feels extremely troubled by his plight as an omega without a mate. Every single month he goes into heat, emitting alluring pheromones and the unwelcome attentions of alphas practically incapacitate him. Niito is desperate to break free, but that means finding a mate... When a handsome stranger saves him from danger, Niito asks to be bonded. But, it turns out that his new mate Aizawa works at the same company!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Niito Is So Naive -Bitten And Bonded in Seconds After Meeting-
title.native: 新戸くんは、世間知らず。～出会って数秒、噛まれてツガって～
title.romaji: Niito-kun wa, Seken Shirazu.: Deatte Suubyou, Kamarete Tsugatte

107619.description:
"If you want a sucker that bad, I've got something for you..." Joji looks like a violent gangster, but he's actually a kind and caring person. Yuu, on the other hand, makes a living with his body. Ever since he found Yuu beaten in an alley, Joji can't say no whenever the boy begs for food or money. Joji is worried about Yuu and makes him promise to find honest work. But, despite his promise, Joji finds Yuu trying to pick up customers again. Yuu doesn't value his life no matter how much danger he's in, and Joji finds himself acting impulsively...! With a caring gangster and a boy of questionable virtue, this is a romantic comedy with a touch of danger!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Originally released under the name Kawaii Obaka to Ii Yakuza (かわいいおバカといいヤクザ).
synonyms: かわいいおバカといいヤクザ

title.native: ヤクザの恋人はアホかわいい

107620.description:
In the middle of a life-or-death tension comes a relentless barrage of outrageous gags and rapid-fire punchlines!? The original creators themselves highly praised this as a “shockingly” hilarious comedy; is now finally available!! As the chaos spirals out of control, can the children successfully pull off their escape…!?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: お約束のネバーランド

107621.description:
Jiang Xue has transferred from school to school ever since she was young, out of specific reasons. This summer, she meets Xia Zhi, our male lead who turns her world upside down. She also meets Shi Haitian who is crazy about her. A story full of youth, dreams, ​and basketball is just about to unfold.

(Source: Webcomics)

107626.description: A girl with a crush gets help from an odd little cat.

107628.description:
I'm Kanade, who looks up to idols and is working part-time at Talent Agency Fantasista. One day, all the talent and staff (aside from the boss, Hayato, and me) were laid off!

I'm asked to become an idol from the boss for the sake of the company, but... What the heck'll happen to my life?! It's an idol's growth story that started when I was young.

title.native: スーパースターは眠れない。

107629.description:
Fleeing tragedy and mistreatment, a young boy named Ren hides among the crowds in Tokyo's busy Shibuya ward. His efforts to run away are more successful than he realizes when he ends up in the world of the beasts! A rough-living bear named Kumatetsu gives Ren a new life and a new name—Kyuta—but is Kumatetsu really up to the job of being a mentor?

(Source: Yen Press)

107631.description: Can you give me a happy ending? Komatsu Risa is in love with her childhood friend, Sano Chihiro. Although they have a very close relationship, and are often mistaken for a couple, Chihiro is unaware of how Risa feels and accepts a confession from another girl... Heartbroken about her first love, she confides in her seemingly indifferent homeroom teacher, Natsuo.

107648.description:
In the past, girls played a dark role as living weapons in wars. They were "transforming girls" who could change shape into airplanes, cars, ships, and more! After the war comes to an end, the girls, no longer needed as weapons, hide their identities to live ordinary lives in school. How is the school life of these girls who do not know the left and right of normal civilian life?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

107649.description:
The sequel and grand finale to the beloved romance comedy Nana and Kaoru are at a crossroads and exams are finally in full swing. It's time to decide their futures, but their secret breathers are heating up more than ever A coming-of-age story depicting a personal way to communicate.

(Source: Denpa)

Note: This series is also sold in compilation volumes under the title Nana to Kaoru Last Year, but the original serialization in the Harem magazine still retains the title Nana to Kaoru: Koukousei no SM gokko, so that will remain the main title.

107650.description: This story begins in the paradise/heaven, where souls, before being born, can choose their mothers. The protagonist notice a girl who has run away from home, and he decides to down to earth and become her son.

107654.description:
Sinjiro lives the life of a coroporate slave, grinding away at a ruthless black company. One day, Fuwami, a mysterious rabbit who was laid off from the moon, crashed into his room! Saying that she will die if she doesn't work, he was forced by fuwami, and ended up hiring another corporate slave...!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

107655.description:
When Takamori Yuuri was a child, he visited the Century Manor, which was owned by his grandfather. Forced to spend the summer there while his parents went away, Yuuri immediately wanted to go home -- until he met a kind boy already living there. He teaches Yuuri origami​ and promises to write him letters when Yuuri has to leave again.
Now 18-years-old, Yuuri finds himself at Century Manor once more. There, he meets his cousins, Fujiwara Yamato, and Takamori Asao. As Yuuri slowly adjusts to his new life, he can’t help but think Yamato’s kindness is nostalgic, and then he finds familiar origami collected in one of the rooms… What memories and feelings will be remembered in this manor?
synonyms: Stardust and First Love Century Manor Love Story

107656.description:
Are these events all a dream? No that can't be... Because I remember everything from a giant dragon fossil, a bird shaped fruit, and a marshmallow garden. The sound of light blue bubbling soda that i heard in my sleep till the moment I wake up, once again lures me back to another world

107657.description:
On the last day of school, Mitsuru, a primary school student who has the power to talk to plants waters a forgotten water hyacinth in his classroom. Since then, strange incidents start occurring in the town of Tsurumaki.

A story of summer vacation in a nostalgic and warm world, drawn by a genius.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

Note: Contains an epilogue.

title.native: つるまき町 夏時間

107658.description:
After the death of his beloved girlfriend, police officer Kyung-Joon just wants to be left alone to water his house plants and catch criminals. But after a police investigation into a mysterious cult goes supernatural, Kyung-Joon finds himself unwillingly caught up in a world of demons, succubi and monsters - and the worst of them all is a demon king calling himself "Lord Cain." It turns out that in order to survive, Cain needs mana that can only be accessed through a "door" inside Kyung-Joon. The problem is... how is he planning to open that door?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 33 extra chapters.

107665.description:
Ayuko Mayama, Kana Aizaki, and Kazuma Oki are a close-knit trio of friends. The three of them end up spending their vacation in S Village, nestled in the mountains, where Kana’s grandmother lives. Surrounded by abundant nature, the three are having a great time, but they’re warned to stay away from just one place: Ojomodera, a temple located near a waterfall. The temple’s proper name was Senyaji, but it was called “Ojomodera” because it was said that a yokai named “Ojomo” appeared there. It was said that the head priests there had gone mad and died one after another, so none of the villagers would go near it, and it had become an abandoned, dilapidated temple. The three promised not to go near it, but while playing outside, they were caught in a sudden summer shower and had to take shelter at Ojomodera.

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

title.native: おじょも寺の妖怪地蔵

107667.description:
Drowning in hesitation, conflict and lust…

(Source: fakku)

107673.description:
Due to the nature of her father's job, Maruko Juri has been changing schools since her elementary years. Since she changes school way too often, she has never really made any memories with anyone except for two boys who she used to call by A-kun and B-kun. Somehow these two boys had left lasting impression in her memories. Particularly A-kun, the boy who made her heart skip beats, the same boy who promised to propose to her seven years into the future after it was decided that she would be leaving his side for the time being.

Juri, now a high school student, somehow made her way back to the same city where she met the two boys after her father got transferred again. She is ready to not get carried away but deep down she hopes to meet the two boys again as she prepares for her very first day in her school. As she starts introducing herself to her new class, a boy steps in, hugs her in front of the whole class and asks her to go out with him. The boy is none other than B-kun. But something is amiss. To her surprise, when she refers to him as B-kun, he says that he now goes by A-kun! Then where is her A-kun she fell for?! What did B-kun mean when he said the A-kun she knew isn't here anymore?!

Shrouded in mystery, will Juri find a new love or will it be her first love, again

"I don't understand why she's always so kind."

Chiyo has loved and admired her sempai since the first time she saw her in a production by the drama club. What is the nature of sempai's kindness towards her? Is her love returned?

title.native: ふわふわ・ふたしか・夢みたい

107678.description:
Truth is a simple thing.

It seemed as though the celebrated old physicist was always destined to stumble upon the young Kazakh boy. For all his fame and recognition, the old man never could have expected his painstakingly crafted approach to the universe would be shattered by the simple thinking of a young boy and his sheep.

(Source: Bikoo)

A collection of Tamura Shigeru's characteristically ethereal and surreal short stories:

107682.description: Yachino Haruma and Shida Ryouhei were once childhood friends as close as brothers. After hearing that Ryouhei has a girlfriend, Haruma masturbates while imagining Ryouhei touching him as he would his girlfriend. Unable to bear the weight of these hidden desires and one-sided love, he distanced himself from his closest friend. Now that high school has brought them back together, is Ryouhei harboring​ hidden desires of his own?

title.native: 優しいパンツの脱がせ方

107683.description:
Once a month, Suzuya lies about being in heat so that he can enjoy paid leave from work. But this lazy omega’s life of leisure is ruined when his new coworker shows up on his doorstep. Furuike offers to help him the best way an alpha can help an omega—with all clothes off! If word gets out that Suzuya lied about being in heat, he’s sure to be fired. His only choice is to pretend to be the lustful omega the alpha thinks he is. But exactly how far is Suzuya willing to go to avoid work?

(Source: Tapas)

107684.description: On his way home, Takayama sees his classmate performing an exorcism.

107685.description: Love is troublesome! But, I can’t stop. Even a second after I fall, trouble starts. How is that love!? Yuuha (senior high school 3rd year) falls in love with anyone who is kind to her or shows her some affection. She is currently, secretly dating Kouno, a university student and a senior at her part-time, gasoline stand job. One day, she hears from her scary junior at work, Kiryuu, that Kouno has another girlfriend? Even though she gets hurt when she falls in love instantly, why did Yuuha go and fall in love yet again...!?

title.native: カンタンだけど、めんどくさい

107687.description:
1-3) Kouzuka Kottouya no Akujiki (好事家骨董屋ノ悪食)
Sagara Naoto is selling things in an antique dealer market. However, his items aren't always worth the money he sells them for. One day, he is found by Kazuyuki Minato who is a former classmate and the owner of an old antique shop. Naoto didn't apologize to Minato, but when Naoto asked him what he wanted, Minato said:​ "Then I would like your body." Naoto was then taken to the antique shop that Minato runs. However, it wasn't to help run the shop but to pay with his body - !?

4-5) Fujinoyu no Venus (富士乃湯のビーナス)
Natsume Yamato is a simple man trying to run his family's bathhouse with his grandmother, but art student and ikemen Rio Oyamada constantly clings to him like a leech. Oyamada calls Yamato his "Venus," his muse and inspiration to paint his art. Yamato only sees Oyamada as a perv who interrupts his daily responsibilities, but somehow when Oyamada's attention isn't on him Yamato becomes more uneasy than he thinks he should be.

107689.description: A high school student, Akito who hates people around him, accidentally took a picture of passing by a ​young girl during his daily routine of taking scenery pictures. Then, he realized it was the girl who recently transferred to his school. He planned to talk to her about the accident of him taking the image but... somehow the girl he took the image of looks different?
synonyms: ขอให้โลกนี้มีแต่รัก

title.native: この世界はツイている

107690.description:
Saki-chan is a beautiful young woman and just a little naive. She may seem harmless as she wanders the streets, but beware–she’s a brand-new succubus who thrives on the lust of men! She’s just…not very good at it yet. When she finds herself with an opportunity to move in with a 30-something man who’s never slept with a woman before, she takes it, just like she’ll take him! Er, eventually. This sweet and sexy comedy about a novice sex demon and her virgin partner will leave you satisfied but always hungry for more.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Saki-chan wa Konya mo Peko Peko

title.native: サキちゃんは今夜もぺこぺこ

107691.description:
My childhood friend is...... the ''campus princess''!? On returning to his hometown after a few years' absence, Chihiro Nakamura is reunited with his best friend from childhood, Yui Amekura. He's excited to see Yui, who has matured beyond recognition. While thrown off by Yui's strange allure, Chihiro's looking forward to a fun-filled school life with his old friend. On the day of his transfer, among the blooming cherry blossoms...... Chihiro can't calm his pounding heart as Yui turns toward him. Chihiro reaches out his hand...... ''Keep your hands off him, asshole!'' It turns out Yui and his alluring aura have been causing mayhem at his all-boys academy. Yui's earned the title of ''campus princess'' and is protected by a team of bodyguards!! What will become of Chihiro's fun school life with Yui? And of this throbbing in his chest......!? This is a pure love story between a faithful, caring guy and his hot-but-oblivious childhood friend!

(Source: Renta!)

107694.description:
On his way home from his office, the main protagonist drove and ran over a big dog. At that moment, he heard the sudden sound of a voice inside his head. ≪The monster has been subjugated, gaining experience points.≫ 「Eh?」 Before anyone knew, the world has changed. Monsters appear, this is a game-like world where levels, skills, and status exist. This is an adventure where the modern world becomes fantasy and where the main protagonist has to strive hard for his survival.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: The World is Full of Monsters Now, Therefor I Want to Live as I With
The World Is Overflowing with Monster, I’m Taking a Liking to This Life

107695.description:
"You have acquired experience points. Kudo Kazuto has risen to Level 1," echoes through Kazuto's mind after he runs over a mysterious dog on his way home from work. The next morning, he awakens to a changed world, full of vicious monsters. The world now features a game-like system of levels and skills, alongside danger at every turn. Will Kazuto be able to survive by leveling up and taking advantage of the special skill he acquired the previous night? His survival adventure begins now!

(Source: Manga UP!)

107698.description: Donald has been fascinated by Noel ever since he first saw him perform on the street, when they were both just boys. As an adult he is now Noel's manager and harboring unrequited feelings of love for him. During a turbulent event where Noel's violin gets stolen, Donald confesses his feelings of love towards him. She was a nurse and vowed to take care of him until he was fully recovered since she owed her life to him. Moreover, all three women he had met earlier also happened to work at the hospital.

107854.description:
The warmest thing in the world is being together. Earnest Kara and flippant Nom live in the second coldest town in the world. Though they get along well, they have clashing personalities. On these ordinary days, they sometimes get irritated or fight over the smallest things. Even then, thanks to the small things like meeting reindeer and penguins or Nom catching a cold, Kara starts thinking about what is really important for them to be living together. The reason why you love the person next to you is right there in your everyday life, just waiting to be found.

(Source: Cork, Inc.)

107856.description:
Hinoharu Kota is newly married but his wife is never home. Bored, Kota imagines being on a relaxing ski trip to clear his mind. In his "dream" everything goes sideways. Still dreaming, Kota walks through a couple of doorways to shockingly find himself springing into action to save a female knight from a giant spider. Kota discovers he was "summoned" to this other world as something known as a summon beast, a helper that can be transported from his earth to other realms. As he completes these summoned missions as a summon beast, he can gain magical powers and abilities. As a man without any special skills on his own earth, this might be the best thing that has ever happened to him.

(Source: Mangamo)

In a dangerous land where fantastical creatures exist, humans must live beside dragons and other supernatural monsters. That's where Mythical Beast Investigators like Ferry come in. Kirishima Tooru is the right-hand man of the Sakuragi crime family. For him, the job is a perfect excuse to let his violent instincts run wild, earning him the nickname “the Demon of Sakuragi”. It seems like nothing will stand in the way of his vicious nature. But then one day, he receives an assignment like never before from the boss—babysitting his daughter! This is the heartwarming (or is it bloodcurdling?) story of a little girl and her yakuza caretaker!

(Source: Kaiten Books)

A lonely monster, living in seclusion in the forest, wishes she could live amidst humans despite her frightening appearance. Everything changes when she starts getting a visitor–a blind human girl who’s fascinated with her mysterious forest friend. As the monster and the girl grow attached in their secluded world, their love proves that beauty is in the eye of the beholder.

Story 2, The White Messenger: Delivering a letter is a simple enough mission, but not when the intended recipient is a disowned royal.

107903.description: Nana was raised by robots, and is now a research student living with Hachitsu, a gifted scientist also raised by robots. One day, Hachitsu collapses from a disease. In order to gain the time to develop a cure to save him, Nana proposes they place him in cold sleep. Hachitsu goes to sleep, leaving behind the clones that he created to help Nana. When he wakes up decades later, Hachitsu finds Nana grown into an old lady and yet more clones. Hachitsu is saved by a surgery, but the elderly Nana seems to be nearing the end of her days. While Hachitsu slept, a war had broken out and devastated the world, and robots and AI who had been turned into weapons had started hating humanity. Nana devoted the rest of her life to creating robots to clean up the earth. She had a dream that humans and AI would be able to reconcile. As she lay on her sickbed, Hachitsu and the clones vowed to carry on her dying wish...

Innocent country boy Miyazawa Kyouhei has just moved to the big city of Tokyo for college. Imagine his shock when a chance meeting with his next-door neighbor, cocky playboy Takara Tomohiro, confirms every one of his fears about wild and debauched city slickers! Kyouhei's self-consciousness is only made worse by Takara's playful, provocative attitude, and the two of them clash right from the start.

Despite that, Takara seems to be going out of his way to look after Kyouhei as he begins to navigate his new life in Tokyo, and Kyouhei finds himself drawn more and more into his orbit. Will the thread of mutual attraction between them prevail over Takara's careless playboy ways? After all, Kyouhei's not looking for a one-night stand — he's looking for serious love!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Jihyun is a master surgeon at the peak of her medical prowess. She’s made it her life’s mission to save lives in order to atone for the sins of her past life, but her dreams are cut short when her plane crashes in the middle of the Pacific. When Jihyun wakes up, she finds herself back in her first life as Elise de Clarence - the haughty nightmare of a girl who brought on her own tragic end. The new Elise, however, still has time to set things straight - with her newfound medical knowledge, the reformed Elise sets out to right the wrongs of her tragic first life!

107975.description:
Meet Galt Luzen, the Demon Lord. Well, the Demon Lord of his own continent, anyway. After his wife passed away, he gradually withdrew from his social life and started to do more of whatever Demon Lords do.

Enter Angelica, the Hero. Heroine. Whatever. She's a paladin of goodness, who wants nothing more than to defeat the Demon Lord. However, she is no match for him and is utterly defeated.

As Galt is not a completely evil Demon Lord, he takes Angelica, still unconscious, as well as the other members of her party, back to their families so they can rest their wounds. As he is bringing back Angelica to her home, however, he meets her mother, Reitia, who is the splitting image of his former wife. As they bond over tea, Galt's feelings get the better of him, and he proposes to Reitia on the spot. Surprisingly, she accepts.

How will Angelica cope with a literal demon for a stepfather? Can Galt take care of someone who has taken a blood oath to kill him? Just what are Demon Lords in this world, anyway, for them to nonchalantly treat the battles of good and evil as if they were sports? Read and find out.

Galtor Luzen, resident Demon Lord on the continent of Masgenia, falls head over heels for the Hero's mother.

Once upon a time, a Demon Lord lost his wife and was all alone. But due to an unexpected turn of events, he met a woman he fell in love with at first sight. She happens to be...a Hero's mother?!

(Source: Comikey)

107977.description:
I was a corporate worker in my 30’s when I woke up and found that I had time leaped to the spring of my second year of high school. At the time, there was a teacher that I had regretted not confessing to, so I confessed to her in the heat of the moment, and now we’re dating! However, the teacher is one who would make any man a good for nothing person, so I end up being spoiled by her a lot.

While secretly dating my overworked teacher (lover), a sweet school life filled with flirting awaits. A 2nd-year high schooler with a 30-year-old me on the inside and the teacher (lover) that I want to pamper, our everyday romantic comedy begins.

Notes:
- Volume 1 contains an extra chapter.
- Volume 2 contains two extra chapters.
- Volume 3 contains an extra chapter.

107978.description:
Seiji Sanada, a nearly 30-year-old corporate drone, woke up one morning to find that he'd been sent back in time to the spring of his sophomore year of high school. Seiji had long regretted graduating without confessing to his beloved world history teacher, Haruka Hiiragi. So this time, he decides to tell her his true feelings...and she's surprisingly okay with it?! The two of them began discretely dating and their life as a couple was bliss... but Hiiragi-sensei is a woman so sweet, she’ll spoil her man rotten! A super flirtatious and rosy school life begins!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 61 chapters with Chapters 29, 40, 55 and 56 split into multiple parts. In the volume releases, these were all combined, as well as Chapters 47 and 48 as Chapter 47. One Tokubetsu-hen (特別編) published on Manga UP! was not included in any of the volumes.
- Includes six extra chapters.

107979.description:
"I became the spirit of elements when I reincarnated?!"

Ellen is a young girl reincarnated from modern-day Japan as a half-spirit. Her father, Rovel, is the legendary hero who saved the kingdom, and her mother, Origin, is the primordial queen and ruler of all spirits. Furthermore, she herself has the overpowered ability to manipulate the elements.

While looking absolutely adorable, this perfect little girl will fall back on her past life's knowledge and the power of the spirits to protect her precious family!

(Source: MANGA UP!)

107981.description:
Mikoto is a beautiful girl who dazzles anyone who sees her. For Masahide, who lost his parents, his younger sister Mikoto is the only "family" he has. One night, however, Mikoto kills a man in front of Masahide's eyes. Innocent love spirals out of control, and the ultimate incestuous suspense begins!

(Source: Shougakukan, translated)

title.romaji: Boku ga Imouto wo Korosu made

107982.description: Tanaka was a salary-man who lived an average life. That life came to an end when he was 41 years old... or it was supposed to. But when he came to, he was standing in a world that resembled Medieval Europe. There was no heating, and food was eaten with your hands. On top of all that, pigs run wild in the city... And in this harsh world, Tanaka would live his second life as "Balian De Lioncourt". Will this average salary-man be able to survive?
synonyms: A History of the Lioncourt War

107985.description: A short story about Ooda-san and her classmate Kitashima-kun, who meet up on a train platform one snowy day.

107987.description:
Bubbly, energetic first-year high school student Himari falls head over heels for her senpai Yori after hearing her band perform on the first day of school. Himari tells Yori she just loves her, and to Himari's surprise, Yori says she loves Himari back! But when Himari realizes that she and her senpai are feeling two different kinds of love, she begins to ask herself what "love" really means...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Notes:
- Eighteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category
- First place in Yuri Navi’s best Yuri Manga of 2020

107988.description:
A young boy meets a mysterious person who gives him a little box which produces a beautiful sound. Short, surreal and poetic.

(Source: Golden Roze & Atelier du Noir)

107989.description: It was a rainy night. A girl in a school uniform named Mitsuru Takada suddenly visits the house of Atsutaka Satou. That day, as she came back from school, her house had become someone else's property. Due to family circumstances, she was passed to many different relatives, but ended up homeless. She sought Atsutaka for help because of the close relationship their late mothers had, and they promised to help each other. Atsutaka was suddenly put into a situation where he has to live with a girl. He hopes that he can get close with her little by little.
synonyms: Living Together With A Stray Cat Girl
How to live with a Noraneko girl.

title.native: ノラネコ少女との暮らしかた

107990.description: Hime Sakuragaike has secretly been in love with her childhood friend Akira Yonezawa since they were kids, but Hime only recently found out that Akira identifies as female. Although surprised, Hime offers her full support, and this is initially kept a ​secret between them for a few years, but Akira decides to start living as a girl full-time upon starting high school with Hime. However, since Akira garners a certain amount of attention, Hime takes it upon herself to aggressively stick up for Akira whenever necessary. Not wanting Akira to be singled out as an object of ridicule, Hime decides that her only option is to put herself in Akira's shoes.
synonyms: The Woman You Are and Me

107991.description: This is a story centered around a male idol band named "Silver Purple" and the two girls that suddenly popped into their lives.

107992.description:
This story takes place during December 0079 U.C. where two brothers are forced to traverse the North American territory as the rear guard of the retreating Principality of Zeon forces, using MSM-04 Acguy amphibious mobile suits, after the Principality fails to capture the Earth Federation's headquarters at Jaburo. However it doesn't take long before these two brothers are the only ones left alive and are faced with the prospect of traveling over two thousand miles, without supplies and backup.

Included one-shot: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Target in Sight
synonyms: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Target in Sight

107994.description: Universal Century 0096. Several months have passed since the incident surrounding Laplace's box also known as the Universal Century Charter. The Earth Federation Forces dispatches a group of investigators to the severed Axis which is drifting outside the Earth Sphere. Two civilians participate as members of the research group: Arlette Almage and Danton Hyleg. Both have pasts with government service to the Principality of Zeon and Neo Zeon as an engineer and test pilot. Having infiltrated Axis, the investigators come under attack inside a base where no one should be. Arlette and Dalton are confronted with an incident they never imagined.

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダム Twilight AXIS

107996.description:
The best maid is actually a delinquent guy?!

I am Ryuunosuke Sakura. In high school, I would get into lots of fights, rising to the position of "boss". So what is a man like me doing as a maid in a maid cafe?

title.native: 佐倉さんご指名ですよ

107997.description:
"I've come to take your virginity."

One day, a man appears before cool, insomniatic office worker Koume. He's haughty, but his looks are exactly her type. He calls himself an incubus and states that he's come to take her virginity...but something about him is weird. A love comedy between an innocent wuss of an incubus and an office lady who won't fall in love!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

107998.description:
Seeking strength and glory, the adventurer Lecan challenges monster and maze alike. Until one day, he finds a mysterious black hole…leading to another world! But even in a different world, the path of the “One-Eyed Wolf” remains unchanged. The only question is—can he survive the new world?

(Source: Yen Press)

107999.description:
Sakura loves when everything is neat, clean, and in its place. She’s on the school Beautification Committee and spends every spare moment mopping or dusting to keep things tidy and perfect. When Sakura is transported to a fantasy world, she’s immediately flabbergasted by how dirty everything is! The land is under a curse which prohibits cleaning magic, and the residents have really let things go. Even the demon king’s castle is a complete mess. Sakura isn’t going to stand for it. She’ll put this kingdom in order, even if it means working directly with the intimidatingly attractive demon king himself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: His Majesty the Demon King’s Housekeeper
